L001.t: Seven Levels of Total Deity Function and the Three Levels of Reality
rows: Creature life and time-space limitations; the Deity level of Supremacy
Without beginnings or endings, transcending time and space; Ultimacy
Beginningless, endless, timeless, and spaceless; Trinity attained
L001.d: The Foreword states that Deity functions on personal, prepersonal, and superpersonal levels, and then lists seven levels on which total Deity is functional. The static, potential, and associative levels describe Deity existing, purposing, and personalizing within itself; on the creative and evolutional levels Deity distributes itself and becomes identified with creatures. The Supreme and Ultimate levels are experiential Deity overcontrolling the grand universe and the master universe. The text then divides reality into finite, absonite, and absolute levels, matching them with the Supremacy of Deity, the Ultimacy of Deity, and the Trinity. Together these lists form the cosmological framework of the whole book and are the key to its later teachings about the Supreme and the Ultimate.

rows: Absolute perfection in some phases and relative perfection in all other aspects
Absolute, relative, and imperfect aspects in varied association
Absolute perfection in some respects, imperfection in all others
Absolute perfection in no direction, relative perfection in all manifestations
Absolute perfection in no phase, relative in some, imperfect in others
Absolute perfection in no attribute, imperfection in all
L002.d: The Foreword explains that divinity may be perfect, as on Paradise, imperfect, as in time-space evolution, or relative, as on certain Havona levels, and then sets out seven conceivable types of perfection. The list begins with absolute perfection in all aspects and shifts the proportion of absolute, relative, and imperfect qualities step by step until it reaches imperfection in all. Notice that perfection is not presented as a simple matter of having it or lacking it but as a graded series of conditions. This distinction shows that even imperfect mortal creatures are not outside the scheme of divinity; they stand on a path that leads through relative perfection toward ever higher perfection.

L003.t: Three Deity-Personality Levels of the Universal Father
rows: The ministry of the Father fragments, such as the Thought Adjusters
The evolutionary experience of created and procreated beings
The eventuated existences of certain absonite and associated beings
L003.d: Cosmic consciousness implies the recognition of a First Cause, the one and only uncaused reality. The Foreword states that God, the Universal Father, functions on three Deity-personality levels of subinfinite value and relative divinity expression. On the prepersonal level he works through Father fragments such as the Thought Adjusters; on the personal level, in the evolutionary experience of creatures; on the superpersonal level, in the eventuated existences of absonite beings. The point of the list is that God is personal, yet not confined within the bounds of personality. This is why the text immediately adds that the word God requires a different definition on each level of Deity function.

L004.t: Seven Meanings of the Word God
rows: Creator, Controller, and Upholder; the Universal Father, First Person of Deity
Co-ordinate Creator, Spirit Controller, Spiritual Administrator; the Eternal Son
Conjoint Actor, Universal Integrator, Mind Bestower; the Infinite Spirit
The actualizing or evolving God of time and space
Deity personality anywhere actually functioning in time and space
The eventuating God of supertime and transcended space
The experientializing God of transcended superpersonal values and divinity meanings
L004.d: The Foreword announces at the outset that the word God is used in these papers with seven meanings. The first three are the persons of the Paradise Trinity, existential Deity from eternity. The last four are experiential Deity, growing or emerging together with the experience of creatures in time and space: God the Supreme, the Sevenfold, the Ultimate, and the Absolute. Knowing this distinction keeps the reader from confusing the levels to which the word God refers throughout the book. The list also condenses one of this revelation's distinctive ideas: God is not only perfect and complete, but also progressively reveals himself as the universes grow.

L005.t: Seven Phases of Infinite Reality: The Seven Co-ordinate Absolutes
L005.d: The Foreword declares that total, infinite reality is existential in seven phases and as seven co-ordinate Absolutes. The first three are the Father, the Son, and the Spirit, the three persons of Deity; the fourth is the Isle of Paradise, nonpersonal and the source of matter. The last three are the Deity Absolute, holding the potentials of deified reality; the Unqualified Absolute, of undeified reality; and the Universal Absolute, which resolves and unifies the tension between them. Notice that the personal and the impersonal, the actual and the potential, are all embraced within these seven. Yet the root of all seven is the First Source and Center, so that God is primal in relation to total reality, unqualifiedly.

L006.t: Seven Relations of the First Source and Center to the Universe
rows: The gravity forces of the material universes
The gravity center of nether Paradise
The Infinite Spirit; cosmic mind in the Seven Master Spirits; Majeston
The unlimited capacity for deity action
The unlimited capacity for infinity response
The two Absolutes, Qualified and Unqualified
Co-ordinated and unified in the Universal Absolute
The potential personality of a moral being
The personality of the Universal Father
L006.d: The First Source and Center is primal in all domains, and no thing or being exists except in relation to and dependence on him. The Foreword sums up that relation in seven lines. Material gravity converges in nether Paradise, mind in the Infinite Spirit, and spirit in the Eternal Son; the capacities for deity action and infinity response reside in two Absolutes, which are in turn unified in the Universal Absolute. It is significant that the last item centers the personality of every moral being in the personality of the Universal Father. Just as each universe force converges on its own center, the personality of a human being is linked directly with the Father.

L007.t: Three Primal Phases in Which Reality Is Realizable
rows: From the energy domains of the nonpersonal to the presence of the Unqualified Absolute
From the lowest finite personality to the presence of the Deity Absolute
A vast domain, potential and actualizing, embraced within the Universal Absolute
L007.d: Reality originates in the infinite volition of the Universal Father and is realizable in three primal phases on many universe levels. Undeified reality ranges from nonpersonal energy to the Unqualified Absolute; deified reality embraces all realms of personality up to the Deity Absolute. Between them lies a vast domain of interassociated reality, difficult of identification by subdeified beings, much of which is embraced within the Universal Absolute. The three phases correspond exactly to the three Absolutes: Deity, Unqualified, and Universal. Read together with the statement that follows, that the Father-initiated divinity-tension is resolved by the Universal Absolute, the list brings the primal structure of reality into clear view.

L008.t: Four Divisions of Reality from the Viewpoint of Time and Space
rows: The Eternal Son is absolute actuality; mortal man an unrealized potentiality
Paradise Deity is existential; the Supreme and Ultimate experiential
Meanings centering in the Eternal Son separated from things centering in Paradise
L008.d: After setting out the primal concept of original reality, the Foreword divides reality again, from the viewpoint of time and space, into four pairs: actual and potential, absolute and subabsolute, existential and experiential, personal and impersonal. Each pair comes with an illustration, and the contrast between the Eternal Son as an absolute spiritual actuality and mortal man as a largely unrealized spiritual potentiality is especially striking. The fourth division explains that the Father's freewill act forever separated the mind-spirit-personal values centering in the Eternal Son from the things that center in the Isle of Paradise. These paired concepts form a basic vocabulary used again and again in the theology and cosmology that follow.

L009.t: Four Levels of Universal Reality in Urantian Human Experience
rows: The material or physical organism of man
The thinking, perceiving, and feeling mechanism of the human organism
The divine spirit that indwells the mind of man, the Thought Adjuster
An experiential acquirement; the emerging and immortal morontial soul
L009.d: The qualities of universal reality represented by the three persons of Deity and the Isle of Paradise are manifest in Urantian human experience on four levels: body, mind, spirit, and soul. The body is the living electrochemical mechanism of animal origin; the mind is the intelligence reaching upward through worship and wisdom toward the spirit level. The spirit is the indwelling Thought Adjuster, and the soul is a new morontial reality fathered by the Adjuster and mothered by the material mind. Immediately after the list the text adds that personality is none of these four but the one changeless reality that unifies them all. This is a far more precise picture of the human being than the old division into body and soul.

rows: Energies deriving from the Unqualified Absolute, as yet unresponsive to Paradise gravity
Responsive to Paradise gravity but as yet unresponsive to local or linear gravity
Directly responsive to linear gravity; the electronic level of energy-matter
L010.d: The revelators explain that such is the paucity of language that they must assign multiple meanings to force, energy, and power, and then define three terms for physical-energy manifestations. The criterion is response to gravity. Cosmic force derives from the Unqualified Absolute but is as yet unresponsive to Paradise gravity; emergent energy responds to Paradise gravity but not yet to linear gravity, the pre-electronic level; universe power responds directly to linear gravity, the electronic level of energy-matter. These three stages form a compact map of how the matter we know emerges out of the potentials of space. They remain the standard reference when reading the later papers on physics and energy.

rows: Beings of eternal existence, past, present, and future
Beings actualizing in the post-Havona present but of unending existence throughout all future eternity
L011.d: The Deity mechanism of the master universe is twofold as concerns eternity relationships. God the Father, God the Son, and God the Spirit are existential, eternal in past, present, and future; God the Supreme, God the Ultimate, and God the Absolute are experiential, actualizing in the post-Havona epochs. It matters that the experiential Deities have an origin but are eternal in destiny. Having achieved existential expression in the Son and the Spirit, the Father is now achieving experiential expression on hitherto unrevealed deity levels. This short list sums up in two words the distinctive concept of this revelation: God is complete and perfect, yet there is also Deity that grows together with the universes.

L012.t: The Evolutionary Creature's Sevenfold Approach to Deity
L012.d: To atone for finity of status and to compensate for creature limitations of concept, the Universal Father has established a sevenfold approach to Deity for evolutionary creatures. The order of the list is the path of ascent. The experiential discovery of God begins with recognizing the divinity of the Creator Son of the local universe, ascends through the superuniverse Ancients of Days and one of the Seven Master Spirits, and finally reaches the discovery of the Universal Father on Paradise. These seven make up God the Sevenfold in time and space, sometime power-personalizing in the Supreme Being. The meaning of the list is that a ladder has been set up for mortals, who cannot reach the infinite Father directly, leading from the nearer Deity to the more remote.

L013.t: The Combined Functions Designated the Action of the Universal Absolute
rows: The all-powerful activator; the Qualified Absolute in which all divinity activities take place
The all-efficient mechanizer; nonpersonal, extradivine, undeified, yet a positive reality
Resolution of the tension between deified and undeified; associative co-ordinator
L013.d: When it is not possible fully to distinguish the Deity Absolute from the Unqualified Absolute, their combined function is designated the action of the Universal Absolute. The Foreword then describes the three in turn. The Deity Absolute is the all-powerful activator, whose every response is made in terms of the welfare of the whole creation and the possibilities of all future eternity. The Unqualified Absolute is devoid of personality and divinity, yet it is not a mere philosophic negativism but a positive reality pervading the grand universe, unlike either pantheism or the old ether hypothesis. The Universal Absolute resolves the tension created when the Father differentiated reality into deified and undeified. Their relationship shows how universe potentials unfold in order.

rows: The Supreme Being, the Supreme Creator Personalities, the absonite Architects of the Master Universe
God the Supreme, God the Ultimate, and the unrevealed Consummator of Universe Destiny
L014.d: Beyond the eternal Paradise Trinity, the Foreword introduces two experiential Trinities that are not now fully manifest but are in process of universe realization. The Ultimate Trinity will consist of the Supreme Being, the Supreme Creator Personalities, and the absonite Architects of the Master Universe, who are neither creators nor creatures; from its unification God the Ultimate will powerize and personalize. The Absolute Trinity will consist of God the Supreme, God the Ultimate, and the unrevealed Consummator of Universe Destiny, and would experientialize Absolute Deity. The revelators frankly say that the Ultimate Trinity is unifying in completion, but they truly doubt the full unification of the Absolute Trinity. The list shows how experiential Deities emerge from the association of prior Deities.

L015.t: Three Experiences That Disclose the Divine Adjuster
rows: The intellectual capacity for knowing God
The spiritual urge to find God
Wholehearted desire to do the Father's will
The personality craving to be like God
L015.d: The existence of God can never be proved by experiment or logic, but it is demonstrated in human experience. Paper 1 finds that evidence in the Thought Adjuster indwelling the human mind. The capacity to know God, the urge to find him, and the craving to be like him are the signs of the Adjuster's presence. Notice that the three phenomena correspond to three dimensions of the human being: intellect, spirit, and personality. The comfort of this list is that the very heart that seeks God is already evidence that God is near.

L016.t: Three Conditions That Limit the Power of God
rows: His infinite love, truth, beauty, and goodness
His mercy ministry and fatherly relationship with the personalities of the universe
The righteousness and justice of the eternal Paradise Trinity
L016.d: The divine omnipotence is perfectly co-ordinated with the other attributes of God's personality; it is not a power to do anything whatever. Paper 3 states that the power of God is ordinarily limited in its universe spiritual manifestation by three conditions. God does nothing contrary to his love and goodness; he acts in accordance with his fatherly will of mercy toward his creatures; and he upholds the law of Trinity righteousness and justice. The key is that nothing outside binds God; his own nature, will, and law determine how his power is used. Read alongside the preceding statement that many things on the evolutionary worlds are not the personal doings of the Universal Father, the list offers a clue to the problem of suffering.

L017.t: Nine Inevitabilities of Evolutionary Creature Life
rows: Grappling with hardships and reacting to disappointments
Faith, the supreme assertion of human thought
A mind that ever knows less than it can believe
A world where error is present and falsehood always possible
Idealism, the approaching concept of the divine
An environment of relative goodness and beauty
The possibilities of betrayal and desertion
The incessant clamoring of an inescapable self for recognition and honor
The alternative of pain and the likelihood of suffering
L017.d: The uncertainties of life and the vicissitudes of existence do not contradict the universal sovereignty of God. Paper 3 shows why through nine questions. If courage is desirable, there must be hardships; if altruism, there must be inequality; if faith, the mind must know less than it can believe. Every item has the same form: a precious quality paired with the difficult environment needed to develop it. Hardship is therefore not evidence of divine indifference but a condition of the school in which character is formed. The text goes on to say that evolving man must be fallible if he is to be free, and it clearly distinguishes the possibility of evil from sin.

L018.t: Three Separate Teachings Combined in the Christian Concept of God
rows: God as a vindicator of moral values, a righteous God
God as a unifier, a God of wisdom
God as a living friend, a loving Father, the divine presence
L018.d: Paper 5 diagnoses the Christian concept of God as an attempt to combine three separate teachings. The Hebrew tradition taught a righteous God, Greek philosophy a God of wisdom who unifies all things, and Jesus a God who is a living friend and loving Father. Because these were blended, composite Christian theology has difficulty attaining consistency, a difficulty aggravated by the fact that early doctrine rested on the personal religious experience of three persons: Philo, Jesus, and Paul. The list is not meant to belittle Christianity; it helps the reader distinguish Jesus' own concept of God within it. The text goes on to say that Jesus upstepped passive love into an active affection that reaches even the wrongdoer.

L019.t: Three Great Satisfactions from Religious Experience
rows: The satisfactions of a more unified human consciousness
The substantiation of his ideals of moral values
The experience of divine companionship, the spiritual satisfactions of true worship
L019.d: The fruits of religious experience are not reserved for the life after death. Paper 5 says that mortal man secures three great satisfactions from religious experience even in the days of his temporal sojourn on earth. Intellectually his consciousness becomes more unified; philosophically his ideals of moral value are substantiated as realities rather than dreams; spiritually he thrives in divine companionship and true worship. These three dimensions mesh with the three levels of God-consciousness described immediately afterward: mind consciousness, soul consciousness, and spirit consciousness. The point of the list is that religion is not one compartment of life but an experience that unifies the whole human being.

L020.t: Three Enterprises of the Divine Plan of Perfection Attainment
rows: The Universal Father's plan of evolutionary ascension; Adjusters and personality
The Father-revelation enterprise of the Eternal Son; bestowal of the Sons of God
Projected by the Infinite Spirit, alone and of himself
L020.d: The divine plan of perfection attainment embraces three marvelously correlated enterprises. The first, the Plan of Progressive Attainment, arises from the Father's proposal, "⟦Q 7:4.4⟧Let us make mortal creatures in our own image⟦/Q⟧," and includes the bestowal of Thought Adjusters and of personality. The second, the Bestowal Plan, is the Eternal Son's enterprise in which the Sons incarnate the Father's love and the Son's mercy on the evolutionary worlds and act as retrievers when rebellion occurs. The third, the Plan of Mercy Ministry, was projected by the Infinite Spirit alone and makes the other two effective in practice. Notice that each person of Deity sponsors one plan in co-operation. On Urantia a Creator Son performed this very service of restoration.

L021.t: Three Great Groups of the Functional Family of the Third Source and Center
rows: Seven Master Spirits, Reflective Spirits, Creative Spirits of the Local Universes
Control creatures and agencies that function throughout all organized space
The Personalities of the Infinite Spirit
Higher Personalities, Messenger Hosts of Space, Ministering Spirits of Time
L021.d: At the close of its account of the Infinite Spirit's activities, Paper 9 sums up the functional family of the Third Source and Center in three great groups. The Supreme Spirits are a group of composite origin, including the Seven Master Spirits, the Reflective Spirits, and the Creative Spirits. The Power Directors are the control creatures and agencies that manage energy throughout organized space. The Personalities of the Infinite Spirit fall into three further classifications: the Higher Personalities, the Messenger Hosts of Space, and the Ministering Spirits of Time. The text carefully adds that this designation does not imply that all are Third Source personalities. The classification maps a vast spiritual family serving from Paradise to the planets, and later papers follow this order.

L022.t: Seven Ways the First Source and Center Functions Outside of Havona
rows: Through the Creator Sons, his grandsons
Through the gravity center of Paradise
Parental contact with all creatures through his personality circuit
His exclusive fragments; in mortal man the Thought Adjusters
L022.d: In the phenomenal universes outside of Havona the Universal Father does most of his work through others. Creation proceeds through the Creator Sons, material control through Paradise gravity, spirit through the Eternal Son, and mind through the Conjoint Creator. Yet two functions he keeps directly: as a Father he maintains contact with every creature through his personality circuit, and as a person he acts within mortal man by the Thought Adjusters. The text stresses that all these delegations are wholly voluntary and self-imposed. The heart of the list is that the Father has entrusted the administration of the universes to others, but has handed over to no one his personal relationship with each of his children.

L023.t: Ten Personalities of the Stationary Sons of the Trinity
L023.d: The Stationary Sons of the Trinity, children of the three Paradise Deities functioning as the Trinity, consist of ten orders. The six orders bearing the name of Days carry on administration and judgment from Havona down to the local universes and constellations, while the Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, and Universal Censors provide wisdom, counsel, and verdicts in the superuniverse governments. Interestingly, the author of this paper is himself a member of the tenth order, the Universal Censors. The text explains that these orders do not represent the attitude of the Trinity in a universal sense, but only in the domains of executive judgment, justice. The meaning of the list is that universe justice is executed not by personal opinion but through beings who come from the Trinity.

L024.t: Three Domains of Activity on the Isle of Paradise
rows: The surface occupied with personality activities, dominated by the Trinity
Activities that are not strictly personal or nonpersonal
The impersonal plane, where the space presence of the Unqualified Absolute is focalized
L024.d: The eternal Isle of Paradise at the center of all things is geographically divided into three domains of activity. Upper Paradise, occupied with personality activities, seems to be dominated by the Trinity; nether Paradise, on the opposite side, is the impersonal plane on which the functional space presence of the Unqualified Absolute is focalized. Between them, peripheral Paradise provides for activities that are not strictly personal or nonpersonal. Paper 11 goes on to describe each domain in turn. This threefold division gives spatial form to the teaching of the Foreword that the personal and the impersonal were separated by the Father's will. It is remarkable that the spirit and the matter of the entire universe take their start on different sides of a single Isle.

L025.t: Three Stages of Response to Paradise Gravity
rows: Individuation of space potency into pre-energy forms of cosmic force; segregata
Energy systems responsive to the pull of Paradise gravity; ultimata
Response to linear gravity; triata in the central universe, gravita in the superuniverses
L025.d: Paradise is the absolute source of all energy-matter in the universe of universes. Paper 11 explains that the many forms of force and energy disclose three general stages according to their response to Paradise gravity. First comes segregata, the primordial force-charge of space; then, through the action of the force organizers, ultimata appear, responsive to Paradise gravity; finally comes universe power, responsive to linear gravity, organized as triata in the central universe and gravita in the superuniverses. The text cautiously notes that these stages are not perfectly clear-cut. The list restates in more concrete physical terms the Foreword's distinction among cosmic force, emergent energy, and universe power.

L026.t: Six Space Levels Encircling the Central Isle
rows: The Fourth and Outermost Space Level
L026.d: Proceeding outward from Paradise, the master universe exists in six concentric ellipses encircling the central Isle. Innermost is Havona, the eternal central universe without beginning or ending; beyond it lie the seven superuniverses, the present organized and inhabited creations. Further out come four outer space levels, where enormous universes are even now in process of formation. This picture shows that our world is not at the edge of creation but relatively close to the center of a creation still destined for vast expansion. At the same time the outer levels, as the future arena of the finaliters and of God the Ultimate, suggest that the story of the universe is far from finished.

L027.t: Four Absolute-Gravity Circuits in the Master Universe
rows: The Personality Gravity of the Universal Father
The Spirit Gravity of the Eternal Son
The Mind Gravity of the Conjoint Actor
The Cosmic Gravity of the Isle of Paradise
L027.d: All forms of force-energy, material, mindal, or spiritual, are alike subject to the grasp of those universal presences called gravity. Personality also responds to gravity, to the Father's exclusive personality circuit. Paper 12 names four absolute-gravity circuits in the master universe: the personality gravity of the Father, the spirit gravity of the Son, the mind gravity of the Conjoint Actor, and the cosmic gravity of the Isle of Paradise. The text adds that these are not force, energy, or power circuits but absolute presence circuits, and like God are independent of time and space. The infinite Father acts not only in his own circuit but over all four. The distinctive feature of the list is that the physical idea of gravity is extended to personality, spirit, and mind.

L028.t: Three Gravity Systems of the Master Universe as Measured on Uversa
cols: Portion Functioning in the Grand Universe
rows: About five per cent of the Paradise absolute-gravity grasp
Practically the entire spirit gravity of the Eternal Son
About eighty-five per cent of the mind-gravity response to the Conjoint Actor
L028.d: After long comparative calculations, the corps of gravity researchers on Uversa reached intriguing conclusions about three gravity systems of the master universe. The grand universe uses only about five per cent of Paradise absolute gravity; the other ninety-five per cent controls material systems in outer space. Practically the entire spirit gravity of the Eternal Son, however, functions in the grand universe, so the universes of outer space are inferred to be at present wholly nonspiritual. About eighty-five per cent of mind gravity originates in the grand universe, which accords with the belief that intelligent force organizers are at work in outer space. The text modestly calls these estimates based on assumed laws, and adds that personality gravity is noncomputable.

L029.t: Three Opinions Concerning the Origin of Motion
rows: We think the Conjoint Actor initiates motion in space
If the Conjoint Actor produces the motions of space, we cannot prove it
The Universal Absolute does not originate initial motion but does equalize and control all the tensions originated by motion
L029.d: Is motion inherent in space? The revelators know that it is not, but they confess they are not so sure about the relation of the Unqualified Absolute to motion. They therefore present the origin of motion not as settled fact but as three opinions. They think the Conjoint Actor initiates motion but cannot prove it, and they hold that the Universal Absolute does not originate initial motion but equalizes the tensions motion produces. What stands out most in this list is that even exalted beings say plainly what they do not know. It reminds the reader that revelation is not a book with an answer for every question but an example of honest inquiry after truth.

rows: Space respiration, the motion of space itself
The alternate directional swings of the successive space levels
Not evaluated with Paradise as a base point
Designed to co-ordinate all other motions
L030.d: From the human viewpoint space seems to be nothing, yet it is real: it contains and conditions motion, and it even moves. Paper 12 roughly classifies space motions into four kinds. Primary motion is space respiration, the expansion and contraction of space itself; secondary motion is the alternate directional swings of the successive space levels. These two are absolute, measured in relation to unmoving Paradise; relative motions are not so evaluated, and compensatory movement co-ordinates all the others. The text goes on to say that our own local creation participates in the two-billion-year cycles of space respiration, which accounts for the apparent outward flight of the surrounding star clusters.

rows: Consciousness of sequence, motion, and a sense of duration
Insight into motion Godward and awareness of ascent to increasing divinity
Insight into Reality plus a consciousness of presence and an awareness of duration
L031.d: Time is not experienced in only one way. Paper 12 distinguishes three levels of time cognizance. The mind is conscious of sequence, motion, and duration; the spirit is aware of motion Godward and of ascent to levels of increasing divinity; and personality creates a unique time sense out of insight into Reality together with a consciousness of presence and an awareness of duration. The text goes on to say that animals know only the past and live in the present, whereas spirit-indwelt man may visualize the future. Therefore only forward-looking and progressive attitudes are personally real, and ethics become truly human only when they are dynamic. The awareness of time becomes a measure of spiritual growth.

L032.t: Four Who Foster the Fundamental Needs of the Master Universe
rows: The Architects of the Master Universe
In administration prior to the appearance of specific rulers
L032.d: Individuals have their guardians of destiny, and every domain from planet to superuniverse has its rulers. But who fosters and cares for the fundamental needs of the master universe as a whole, from Paradise to the outermost space level? Existentially such overcare is probably attributable to the Paradise Trinity, but experientially the appearance of the post-Havona universes depends on four: the Absolutes in potential, the Ultimate in direction, the Supreme in evolutionary co-ordination, and the Architects of the Master Universe in administration where no specific rulers have yet appeared. The text adds that the Ultimate will be space present to the outer margins of the fourth space level, progressively integrating the potentials of the three Absolutes. The reassurance of the list is that no region of space, however remote, is left uncared for.

L033.t: Three Functioning Levels of Finite Reality
rows: Organized energy subject to linear gravity
Organized consciousness not wholly subject to material gravity; liberated by spirit
The highest personal reality; not subject to physical gravity
L033.d: Though the mortal mind can hardly comprehend the seven levels of relative cosmic reality, it should be able to grasp much of the meaning of three functioning levels of finite reality. Matter is organized energy subject to linear gravity except as modified by motion and conditioned by mind. Mind is organized consciousness not wholly subject to material gravity, which becomes truly liberated when modified by spirit. Spirit is the highest personal reality and eventually becomes the motivating influence of all evolving energy systems of personality dignity. The text goes on to say that the goal of existence of all personalities is spirit, with mind intervening between the universal opposites of matter and spirit. Because God is spirit, spirit is the fundamental reality of creature personality experience.

L034.t: The Seven Sacred Worlds of the Father
rows: Bosom of the Father; Paradise rendezvous of the Thought Adjusters
Bosom of the Son; personal receiving world of the Eternal Son
Bosom of the Spirit; home of beings representing the Infinite Spirit
Bosom of the Father and the Son
Bosom of the Father and the Spirit
Bosom of the Son and the Spirit; destiny sphere of the angelic hosts
Bosom of the Father, Son, and Spirit; rendezvous of the ascendant creatures
L034.d: The innermost of the three circuits of Paradise satellites is the Father's circuit of seven sacred worlds. Each enjoys a specialized manifestation of the Deities and is directed by the Trinitized Secrets of Supremacy. The order of names and bosoms is strikingly symmetrical: the bosoms of Father, Son, and Spirit come first, then the paired bosoms, and finally Ascendington, the bosom of all three. Divinington holds the secret of the Thought Adjusters, Sonarington the secret of the incarnation of the divine Sons. The author confesses that he is somewhat familiar with six of these worlds but has never landed on Divinington. Nearest to mortals is the last, Ascendington, the actual home of ascending pilgrims during most of their Havona sojourn.

L035.t: Seven Space Conditions and Motions from Paradise to the Superuniverses
rows: The quiescent midspace zones impinging on Paradise
The clockwise processional of the three Paradise and the seven Havona circuits
The semiquiet space zone separating the Havona circuits from the dark gravity bodies
The inner, counterclockwise-moving belt of the dark gravity bodies
The second unique space zone dividing the two space paths of the dark gravity bodies
The outer belt of dark gravity bodies, revolving clockwise around Paradise
A third, semiquiet zone separating the outer belt from the innermost superuniverse circuits
L035.d: Paper 14 describes the physical structure of the central universe in seven layers, from the periphery of Paradise to the inner borders of the seven superuniverses. It begins with the quiescent midspace zones, then the clockwise processional of the Paradise satellites and Havona worlds, and beyond that the two belts of dark gravity bodies moving in opposite directions. Quiet or semiquiet space zones lie between them, dividing each layer from the next. The alternating directions of revolution echo the earlier teaching about the alternate directional swings of successive space levels. That the billion worlds of Havona are set within such exquisitely balanced belts gives a vivid picture of the order of the perfect universe.

L036.t: Seven Basic Life Groups of the Central Universe
L036.d: There are seven basic forms of living things and beings on the Havona worlds. Each basic form exists in three phases, each phase in seventy major divisions, and each major division in one thousand minor divisions, with ever further subdivisions. The seven groups rise from the material through the morontial and spiritual to the absonite, ultimate, coabsolute, and absolute. In a sense, the stages that mortals pass through in their ascent are already present in the perfect universe as forms of life. The text goes on to say that decay and death are not a part of the cycle of life on the Havona worlds; even the lower living things change form without decay or cellular death. The list shows how abundant life is in a perfect creation.

L037.d: The range of the activities of seven-circuited Havona is enormous, and Paper 14 describes them in general under three heads: activities proper to Havona itself, those related to Paradise, and those concerned with ascending finite creatures evolving toward the Supreme and the Ultimate. This short list shows that the perfect central universe is not merely a self-contained world but a bridge between Paradise and the evolutionary universes. The author modestly grants that the central universe may serve many purposes not revealed to him, functioning in ways beyond the comprehension of the created mind. He then proceeds at once to depict how this perfect creation ministers to the needs and satisfactions of seven orders of universe intelligence.

L038.t: Seven Orders of Universe Intelligence and Their Satisfactions in Havona
rows: Supreme parental satisfaction from the perfection of the central creation
Eternal proof of the partnership effectiveness of the divine family
Proof of being the Conjoint Actor
Eternal and perfect proof of the spiritual reality of the Supreme Being
The educational training ground for universe creation
Prepersonal training of the Universe Mother Spirits
The Evolutionary Mortals of the Ascending Career
The home of the pattern personality of every mortal type
L038.d: For whom does the perfect central universe exist? The last section of Paper 14 explains what Havona affords to each of seven orders of universe intelligence. To the Father it gives the adoration of perfect creatures and love satiety; to the Son, proof of the partnership effectiveness of the divine family; to the Spirit, proof of being the Conjoint Actor. To the Supreme Being it is proof of spiritual reality; to the Creator Sons and the Universe Mother Spirits, a training ground; to mortals, the home of their pattern personalities. Notice that the same universe means something different to each, from Deity down to mortals. Especially telling is the Father's view of Havona as the alluring goal of his mortal grandchildren: the end of the ascension journey is already prepared.

L039.t: Seven Constituents of the Superuniverses and Their Inhabitable Worlds
rows: About one thousand inhabited or inhabitable worlds; a System Sovereign
One hundred systems (about 100,000 inhabitable planets); the Most Highs
One hundred constellations (about 10,000,000 inhabitable planets); a Creator Son
One hundred local universes (about 1,000,000,000 inhabitable planets); Recents of Days
One hundred minor sectors (about 100,000,000,000 inhabitable worlds); Perfections of Days
Ten major sectors (about 1,000,000,000,000 inhabitable planets); Ancients of Days
Seven superuniverses (approximately seven trillion inhabitable worlds); Seven Master Spirits
L039.d: All seven superuniverses of the grand universe are organized on the same plan. About one thousand worlds adapted to support life make a system; these are grouped by hundreds into constellations, local universes, minor sectors, and major sectors, and ten major sectors constitute a superuniverse. Each unit has its headquarters world and its rulers, from the System Sovereign and the Most Highs through the Creator Son to the Recents, Perfections, and Ancients of Days. The number of inhabitable worlds multiplies a hundredfold at most steps, reaching approximately seven trillion in the grand universe. The list serves as a kind of cosmic address book, locating our planet precisely within the administrative structure of the whole.

L040.t: Seven Multiple Revolutionary Movements Around Uversa
rows: The revolution of Urantia around its sun
The circuit of your solar system about the nucleus of the former Andronover nebula
The rotation of the Andronover stellar family about the rotation-gravity center of the Nebadon star cloud
The swing of the local star cloud of Nebadon around the Sagittarius center of its minor sector
The rotation of the one hundred minor sectors, including Sagittarius, about their major sector
The whirl of the ten major sectors, the so-called star drifts, about the Uversa headquarters
The movement of Orvonton and six associated superuniverses around Paradise and Havona
L040.d: Some of the confusion of Urantian star observers arises from illusions produced by multiple, overlapping revolutionary movements. Paper 15 sets them out in seven layers. Urantia revolves around its sun; the solar system circles the nucleus of the former Andronover nebula; that stellar family rotates about the center of the Nebadon star cloud, and the star cloud swings around the Sagittarius center. The minor sectors in turn rotate about their major sector, the major sectors whirl about Uversa, and finally all Orvonton moves with the other superuniverses in the counterclockwise processional around Paradise and Havona. The text explains that the first and last motions are genetic, while the intervening ones are of composite origin, partly produced by the purposeful action of the force organizers.

L041.t: Ten Groups of Origin for Suns, Planets, and Other Spheres
rows: Suns thrown off great mother wheels of highly heated gases
Tidal convulsions and eruptions when passing near an enormous mass
Matter thrown off by enormous suns of accelerated revolution
By-products of sun fission at the critical size limit
The largest outer planet draws to itself its neighboring worlds
Growth by meteoric accretion and minor collisions
Isolated suns with all available space-energy emitted
Built according to plans and specifications for some special purpose
L041.d: Paper 15 classifies the majority of suns, planets, and other spheres into ten groups according to origin. It describes in turn nebulae condensing into rings, gaseous wheels throwing off suns, tidal convulsions producing explosive eruptions, rapidly revolving suns casting off matter, and then fission, contraction, accretion, and collision. There is even a concrete example of how our solar system might someday be reorganized around Jupiter. The first nine origins are evolutionary; only the last, the architectural worlds such as Salvington and Uversa, are built to specification. The text adds that there are almost one hundred different modes of formation, so this list presents only the principal ones. Behind it lies the conviction that even the birth of stars is part of an orderly universe plan.

L042.t: Five Major Divisions of the Spheres of Space
rows: Minor space bodies—comets, meteors, and planetesimals
The planets, including the inhabited worlds
L042.d: Where the preceding list classified spheres into ten groups by origin, this one sorts the spheres of space into five major divisions irrespective of origin: the luminous suns, the dark islands that emit no light, minor space bodies such as comets and meteors, the planets including the inhabited worlds, and the architectural spheres made to order. Paper 15 then goes on to describe each division in turn. The text states that, except for the architectural spheres, all space bodies have had an evolutionary origin, meaning that they were not brought into being by fiat of Deity, but that God's creative acts unfolded by a time-space technique through the operation of many created and eventuated intelligences. Here evolution and creation are not set against each other.

L043.t: Six Headquarters Worlds from Jerusem to Uversa
rows: System of Satania; seven worlds of transition culture, including the mansion worlds
Constellation of Norlatiadek; seventy satellites of socializing culture and training
Local universe of Nebadon; ten university clusters of forty-nine spheres each
Minor sector of Ensa; seven spheres of the higher physical studies
Major sector of Splandon; seventy spheres of advancing intellectual training
Superuniverse of Orvonton; seven higher universities of advanced spiritual training
L043.d: The headquarters worlds of the universes are provided with every phase of material, morontial, and spiritual creation, and ascending mortals pass through their training spheres at each stage. Paper 15 introduces six headquarters in order, from Jerusem of our system to Uversa of our superuniverse. Postmortal life begins on the mansion worlds of Jerusem; on Edentia the ascender is socialized, and on Salvington spiritualized. Physical and intellectual studies follow on Uminor and Umajor, and in the seven higher universities of Uversa the pilgrim prepares for the long flight to Havona. The text notes that mortals never lose their appreciation for, and enjoyment of, their former levels of existence. The list itself is a map of the mortal ascension.

L044.t: Seven Superuniverse Circuits of the Deities
rows: The unifying intelligence circuit of one of the Seven Master Spirits
The reflective-service circuit of the seven Reflective Spirits
The secret circuits of the Mystery Monitors
The circuit of the intercommunion of the Eternal Son with his Paradise Sons
The flash presence of the Infinite Spirit
The broadcasts of Paradise, the space reports of Havona
The energy circuits of the power centers and the physical controllers
L044.d: The universal circuits of Paradise, the four presence circuits of the Father, the Son, the Conjoint Actor, and the eternal Isle, do actually pervade the seven superuniverses. Beyond these, only two energy-circuit divisions function within the superuniverse space level: the superuniverse circuits and the local universe circuits. This list names the seven superuniverse circuits: the cosmic-mind circuit of a Master Spirit, the circuit of the Reflective Spirits, the secret circuits of the Mystery Monitors routed by Divinington to the Father, the intercommunion of the Son with his Sons, the flash presence of the Infinite Spirit, the broadcasts of Paradise, and the physical energy circuits. Because mind, spirit, communication, and energy are all linked by circuits, the superuniverse operates as one living network.

L045.t: Three Local Universe Circuits of the Deities
rows: The bestowal spirit of the Paradise Sons
The Comforter of the bestowal worlds; the Spirit of Truth, the spirit of Michael on Urantia
The circuit of the Divine Ministers
The local universe Mother Spirits, the Holy Spirit of your world
The intelligence-ministry circuit of a local universe
Including the presence of the adjutant mind-spirits
L045.d: Following the superuniverse circuits, Paper 15 names three circuits functioning in the local universe. The first is the bestowal spirit of the Paradise Sons, which on Urantia is the spirit of Michael, the Spirit of Truth. The second is the circuit of the Divine Ministers, the local universe Mother Spirits, the presence known on our world as the Holy Spirit. The third is the intelligence-ministry circuit, including the adjutant mind-spirits that minister to the minds of evolutionary creatures. These three are especially significant because they are the divine influences closest to everyday human experience. The text goes on to say that when the local universe circuits become indistinguishable from those of the superuniverse, that universe swings into the settled circuits of light and life.

L046.t: Two Requisites for Admission to the Councils of the Ancients of Days
rows: Stars and planets in equilibrium; the orbit safely and finally settled
Universal recognition of, and loyalty to, the Sovereign Son; harmonious co-operation
L046.d: When such spiritual harmony develops in a local universe that its circuits become indistinguishable from those of the superuniverse, it swings into the settled circuits of light and life and becomes eligible for admission into the superuniverse confederation. There are two requisites. Physical stability means that stars and planets are in equilibrium and the orbit is finally settled; spiritual loyalty means universal recognition of the Sovereign Son who presides over the local universe, with harmonious co-operation among its planets, systems, and constellations. Notice that physical order and spiritual order must be achieved together. The text frankly states that Nebadon is not yet even reckoned as belonging to the settled physical order and has no representation on Uversa, while adding that the superuniverse government lends every possible assistance.

L047.t: Seven Groups in the Executive Branch of the Superuniverse Government
rows: The joint chief executives of the supergovernment
L047.d: Each superuniverse is presided over by three Ancients of Days, the joint chief executives, and the executive branch of the supergovernment consists of seven groups. The first four, the Ancients of Days, Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, and Universal Censors, take origin directly in the Paradise Trinity. The last three, however, the Mighty Messengers, Those High in Authority, and Those without Name and Number, are, remarkably, glorified ascendant mortals. Having passed through Havona and attained Paradise, they were mustered into the Corps of the Finality, embraced by the Trinity, and assigned to the service of the Ancients of Days. That former mortals of animal origin share in the highest government of the superuniverse shows how great the possibilities of the ascension career are.

L048.t: Seven Groups Added to the Co-ordinate Council of the Superuniverse
rows: The rulers of the superuniverse major sectors
The directors of the superuniverse minor sectors
The Paradise advisers to the rulers of the local universes
The Paradise counselors to the Most High rulers of the constellation governments
Who may chance to be on duty at superuniverse headquarters
Who may happen to be present at superuniverse headquarters
Spokesmen of the seven Reflective Spirits, representatives of the Master Spirits
L048.d: The co-ordinate council of a superuniverse is composed of the seven executive groups previously named together with the sector rulers and other regional overseers. The list moves from the rulers of the major and minor sectors to the Paradise advisers stationed with local universe and constellation governments, then to Trinity Teacher Sons and Eternals of Days who may happen to be present, and finally to the Reflective Image Aids. Superuniverse government thus appears not as a one-way chain of command but as a council in which many levels are represented together. The Reflective Image Aids deserve special notice, for they also represent groups not yet fully active in their individual capacities, including the evolving superuniverse personality manifestation of the Supreme Being.

L049.t: The Seven Likenesses of the Seven Master Spirits
L049.d: The Seven Master Spirits are primary personalizations of the Infinite Spirit, yet each derives his individual characteristics from one of the seven possible associations of the three persons of Paradise Deity. Three resemble a single person, three resemble a pair, and the last resembles all three together. Since three Deity persons allow exactly seven such combinations, the number of the Master Spirits is no accident but an inevitability rooted in the nature of Deity. In spirit character they are as one, but in all other aspects of identity they are very unlike, and these differences condition the seven superuniverses. That the Spirit presiding over our own Orvonton equally portrays Father, Son, and Spirit follows directly from this list.

rows: The direct representation of the Paradise Father
Portrays the matchless nature and charming character of the Eternal Son
Partakes of the combined natures of the Father and the Son
Exquisitely blends the character of the Universal Father and the Infinite Spirit
Portrays the combined character of the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit
A uniquely equal portrayal of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit
L050.d: The Seven Master Spirits are indescribable beings, yet distinctly personal. They have names, but the revelators introduce them by number. Each Spirit, according to the Deity person or association he resembles, advises a particular group of beings, speaks for that Deity in the councils of the Seven, and rules his superuniverse much as that Deity would. Each is always in liaison with the Reflective Spirits at his superuniverse headquarters. The Seventh Master Spirit receives the fullest treatment. He presides over Orvonton, our own superuniverse, and during the present age of the noncontactability of the person of the Supreme he functions in the place of the God of ascendant creatures. His administration therefore discloses a marvelous symmetry in the co-ordinate blending of the divine natures of Father, Son, and Spirit.

L051.t: Seven Probable Influences of the Master Spirit of Orvonton
rows: The life-initiation procedures of the local universe Life Carriers
The life activations of the adjutant mind-spirits
The fluctuations in energy manifestations of linear-gravity-responding units of organized matter
The behavior of emergent energy when fully liberated from the Unqualified Absolute
The bestowal of the ministry spirit of a Creative Spirit, the Holy Spirit
The bestowal of the spirit of the bestowal Sons, the Spirit of Truth
The reflectivity mechanism of the local universes and the superuniverse
L051.d: The revelators admit that they cannot offer definite proof, yet they consider it highly probable that the Master Spirit of Orvonton exerts a decided influence in seven spheres. The list covers the initiation of life and the activation of the adjutant mind-spirits, fluctuations of physical energy and the behavior of emergent energy, the bestowals of the Holy Spirit and the Spirit of Truth, and the mechanism of reflectivity. Physical, mindal, and spiritual realms all appear, showing that the work of a Master Spirit is not confined to one dimension of reality. Immediately afterward the text marks the limits of this influence: the Master Spirits have nothing whatever to do with the bestowal of Thought Adjusters or with the functions of the Unqualified Absolute. The passage shows a careful distinction between conjecture and certainty.

L052.t: Three Levels of Universe Reality to Which the Cosmic Mind Responds
rows: The reality domain of the physical senses; the mathematical form of cosmic discrimination
The reality domain of morals in the philosophic realm; the judicial form
The spiritual domain of religious experience; the reverential and worshipful form
L052.d: The cosmic mind unfailingly responds on three levels of universe reality, and these responses are self-evident to clear-reasoning minds. The first is causation, the domain of the physical senses and the logical uniformity of science. The second is duty, the domain of morals, where reason recognizes relative right and wrong. The third is worship, the spiritual domain in which divine fellowship is personally realized and the soul ascends from the status of servants of God to the joy and liberty of the sons of God. These three correspond to science, philosophy, and religion, and they form the a priori assumptions that enable man to function as a rational, self-conscious personality. The revelators note that living experience always develops these intuitions, yet regret that so few cultivate courageous cosmic thinking.

L053.t: Seven Areas of Man's Relative Free Will
rows: Wholehearted devotion to doing the Father's will
The sincere pursuit of divine values and the wholehearted love of the divine Value-Giver
L053.d: Human free will is relative rather than absolute, yet it is precisely this freedom that characterizes the self-consciousness of human personality. Paper 16 names seven areas in which that freedom actually operates. The order rises from moral decision through spiritual choice, love and co-operation, and cosmic insight, to personality dedication and worship. Freedom begins in simple judgments and is completed in wholehearted love for God. That worship is the highest use of free will means that freedom is not a power to move away from God but the power to come to him of one's own choice.

L054.t: Three Basic Mind Realities of the Cosmos
rows: The mathematical or logical recognition of the uniformity of physical causation
The reasoned recognition of the obligation of moral conduct
The faith-grasp of the fellowship worship of Deity, associated with the loving service of humanity
L054.d: When the divine gift of personality is bestowed upon a mind-endowed mortal mechanism, it confers the dignity of cosmic citizenship and enables the creature forthwith to recognize the three basic mind realities of the cosmos. The first is the mathematical or logical recognition of uniform physical causation; the second, the reasoned recognition of moral obligation; the third, the faith-grasp of fellowship with Deity, joined to loving service of humanity. This restates the earlier levels of causation, duty, and worship from the side of human personality. The text adds that the full function of such a personality endowment is the beginning realization of Deity kinship. Worth noting is that worship is not separated from the loving service of one's fellows.

L055.t: Four Universe-Reality Realizations Latent in Human Self-Consciousness
rows: Recognizing God as a personality and our fraternal relationship with fellow personalities
L055.d: Self-consciousness, the revelators say, is in essence a communal consciousness: God and man, Father and son, Creator and creature. True self-awareness arises only within such relationships. Four quests lie latent in human self-consciousness: the quest for knowledge, following the logic of science; the quest for moral values, felt as the sense of duty; the quest for spiritual values, issuing in religious experience; and the quest for personality values, the ability to recognize God as a personality together with the realization of our brotherhood with fellow personalities. The first three echo the earlier levels of science, morality, and worship, while the fourth is newly added. The following text explains that we become conscious of man as brother because we are already conscious of God as Creator Father, binding fatherhood and brotherhood together.

L056.t: Three Groups Classified as Children of the Paradise Trinity
L056.d: The seven Supreme Spirit groups are the universal co-ordinating directors of the seven-segmented administration of the grand universe. All are classed among the functional family of the Infinite Spirit, yet three of them, the Seven Master Spirits, the Seven Supreme Executives, and the Reflective Spirits, are usually classified as children of the Paradise Trinity. These groups stand on Paradise, its satellites, and the superuniverse headquarters, overseeing the whole grand universe from on high. The remaining four groups, which follow immediately, are brought into being by the Infinite Spirit or his creative associates, so the seven divide by origin into three and four. One family in function but different in origin, this distinction illustrates how the papers classify beings by origin and by function separately.

L057.t: Four Groups Created by the Infinite Spirit or His Associates
rows: The Seven Spirits of the Circuits
L057.d: Of the seven Supreme Spirit groups, the first three are classed as children of the Trinity, while the remaining four are brought into being by the creative acts of the Infinite Spirit or his associates of creative status. Hence their numbering runs from four to seven. The Reflective Image Aids serve at superuniverse headquarters, the Seven Spirits of the Circuits in the Havona circuits, the Creative Spirits in the local universes, and the adjutant mind-spirits within the minds of creatures on evolutionary worlds. Read in order, the list traces the functional domain of spirit from the periphery of the eternal Isle down to the lowly service of the worlds of time and space. It is notable that the ordinary workings of human mind are touched by the farthest ministry of this vast spirit family.

L058.t: Seven Stages of Existence of a Local Universe Mother Spirit
rows: The supreme reaction of complement in the Infinite Spirit
The future consort becomes group conscious of destiny
The prayer of identification; material organization of the universe
The personalization ceremonies and the primary eruption
The Creator Son elevates the Mother Spirit to cosovereignty
The Ages of Light and Life
The sixth phase of a Creative Spirit's career
L058.d: The Universe Mother Spirit, consort of a Creator Son, does not appear as a finished personality but grows through successive stages over long ages. Her career begins with the supreme reaction of complement in the Infinite Spirit when a Creator Son is personalized, then passes through preliminary training, physical creation, and life creation, during which an impersonal entity becomes manifestly personal. When the Creator Son completes his seventh bestowal and acquires full sovereignty, he elevates her to cosovereignty and acknowledges her as his equal. The ages of light and life follow, and the revelators cautiously conjecture a seventh, unrevealed career. The list teaches that even divine beings grow through experience, and that a Creator Son and a Creative Spirit work together as complements in the making of a universe.

L059.t: Five Ways the Master Spirits Co-ordinate the Activities of God the Sevenfold
rows: Collectively they near-equivalate to the divinity level of the Trinity of Paradise Deities
Individually they exhaust the primary associable possibilities of triune Deity
Repositories of the spirit-mind-power sovereignty of the Supreme Being
Through the Reflective Spirits they synchronize superuniverse governments with Majeston
They contribute to the last level of God the Sevenfold, the Creator Son-Creative Spirit union
L059.d: The seven Supreme Spirit groups co-ordinate the inhabited creation, and the association of their directing heads, the Seven Master Spirits, appears to co-ordinate the far-flung activities of God the Sevenfold. The list names five aspects of this work. Collectively the Master Spirits approach the divinity level of the Trinity; individually they exhaust the possible associations of triune Deity. They hold in trust the sovereignty the Supreme Being does not yet personally exercise, link the superuniverse governments with Majeston through the Reflective Spirits, and share in the individualization of the local universe Divine Ministers. They thus bind together every level of God the Sevenfold, from Paradise Deity to the Creator Son-Creative Spirit union of the local universes. In the perfected future this functional unity will become inseparable from the experiential sovereignty of the Supreme.

L060.t: The Seven Orders of Supreme Trinity Personalities
L060.d: Supreme Trinity Personalities are all created by the divine Trinity for specific service, qualified to serve with perfection of technique and finality of devotion. The list descends from the Trinitized Secrets of Supremacy, who serve near Paradise, through the Eternals of Days of the Havona worlds and the Ancients of Days who rule the superuniverses, to the rulers of the major and minor sectors, and finally to the Unions of Days and Faithfuls of Days stationed with local universes and constellations. Their numbers are definite and final; no more are being personalized. Throughout the grand universe they represent the administrative policies and the justice of the Paradise Trinity, forming an interrelated line of administrative perfection from the Father's spheres to the constellation capitals. There is never any risk of default or rebellion with Trinity-origin beings.

L061.t: Seven Groups of Co-ordinate Trinity-Origin Beings
L061.d: This Paradise group, designated the Co-ordinate Trinity-origin Beings, falls into seven classes: the Trinity Teacher Sons, also classed among the Paradise Sons of God; three groups of high superuniverse administrators, the Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, and Universal Censors; the somewhat impersonal Inspired Trinity Spirits; and the Havona Natives and Paradise Citizens who inhabit the central universe and the eternal Isle. Whereas the Supreme Trinity Personalities chiefly govern, these beings serve in more varied ways: teaching, wisdom, counsel, judgment, and inspiration. Except for the Trinity Teacher Sons and possibly the Inspired Trinity Spirits, their numbers are definite and their creation is a finished event. The Trinity Teacher Sons are especially notable, for being of Trinity origin yet devoted to the services of sonship, they bridge the gulf between Trinity- and dual-origin personalities.

L062.t: Four Errors of Reasoning in Approaching the Higher from the Lower
rows: Failing to perceive the final and completed evolutionary goal of personal attainment or cosmic destiny
Oversimplifying cosmic evolutionary reality, distorting facts and perverting truth
Taking how a being becomes for its present status and true character
Expecting history alone to reveal future development—destiny
L062.d: Whether in biology or theology, the philosophic technique of starting from the lower to approach the higher is always in danger of four errors of reasoning. It may miss the final goal, oversimplify evolutionary reality, mistake the history of origins for the true character of the present, and try to read destiny from the past alone. Finite origins are helpful, the revelators say, but only divine causes reveal final effects, and the present can be truly interpreted only in the light of the correlated past and future. For these reasons the papers do not begin with man but embark on the time-space journey from the infinite, eternal, and divine Paradise Source and Center of all personality and existence. The list is a methodological confession explaining why the whole book moves from God toward man.

L063.t: Three Possible Types of Creatures to Reside in Havona
rows: The univitatia, at present the permanent citizens of the local universe constellations
Future types of mortals born in the flowering of the ages of light and life
The incoming spiritual aristocracy of the successive outer universes
L063.d: Havona natives are constantly filtering into the Paradise Corps of the Finality, and no more are being created, so the number remaining in the central universe is steadily diminishing. The revelators do not believe Havona will ever be entirely depleted of its natives, and they cautiously suggest three types of beings who may come to reside there: the univitatia, now permanent citizens of the local universe constellations; future types of mortals born on the superuniverse worlds in the flowering of light and life; and the spiritual aristocracy arriving from the successive outer universes. They add that the Havona of the previous universe age differed from that of the present, and conclude that the universe is nonstatic; only God is changeless. Even the perfect central universe is slowly changing in anticipation of the ages to come.

L064.t: Three General Classes of the Sons of God
L064.d: As they function in the superuniverse of Orvonton, the Sons of God are classified under three general heads. Descending Sons are personalities of direct and divine creation who come down to serve the worlds of time and space. Ascending sons, such as mortal creatures, achieve their status by experiential participation in the creative technique known as evolution. Trinitized Sons are a group of composite origin, including all beings embraced by the Paradise Trinity even though not of direct Trinity origin. The classification shows that sonship is not fixed by birth alone but opens along three paths: descending in service, ascending through attainment, and being embraced by the Trinity. Its great significance for us is that mortal man, as an ascending son, belongs to the family of the Sons of God.

L065.t: Three Orders of the Paradise Sons of God
L065.d: All descending Sons of God have high and divine origins and come down to the worlds of time and space to facilitate the Paradise climb of the lowly creatures of evolutionary origin. Of the seven orders depicted in these narratives, the three that come forth from the Deities on the central Isle of Light and Life are called the Paradise Sons of God: the Creator Sons, or Michaels; the Magisterial Sons, or Avonals; and the Trinity Teacher Sons, or Daynals. They create universes, judge and bestow themselves upon the worlds, and teach truth. The remaining four orders are known as the Local Universe Sons of God. Since Michael of Nebadon, who came to Urantia as Jesus, belongs to the first of these orders, the list also introduces the divine Son who stands closest to us.

L066.t: The Threefold Function of Avonals on the Inhabited Worlds
rows: Dispensation terminators, liberators of the sleeping survivors
Usually before a bestowal Son; appearing as an adult without mortal birth
Bestowal upon some mortal race; born of woman
L066.d: The Magisterial Sons, the Avonals, serve on higher administrative levels, but on the inhabited worlds they have a threefold function. In judicial actions they come at the close of the planetary dispensations as dispensation terminators and liberators of the sleeping survivors, and such missions may occur scores or hundreds of times on one world. On magisterial missions, usually before the arrival of a bestowal Son, they appear as adults of the realm by a technique of incarnation not involving mortal birth. On bestowal missions every Avonal at least once bestows himself upon some mortal race and is born of woman, as Michael of Nebadon was on Urantia. The list moves from the frequent to the singular: judicial visits are numerous, magisterial missions may be plural, but each planet receives only one bestowal Son.

L067.t: Three Limitations on the Creator Prerogatives of a Local Universe Father
rows: Energy-matter is dominated by the Infinite Spirit
Creature designs and types are controlled by the Eternal Son
Personality is designed and bestowed by the Universal Father
L067.d: When a Michael Son departs from Paradise to organize his universe, his creator prerogatives are forever liberated from the Paradise Sources and Centers, yet certain limitations inherent in their pre-existence remain. Before any new forms of things may be created or energy-matter transformed, he must secure the consent and working co-operation of the Infinite Spirit; before creating any new type of being, he must secure the consent of the Eternal Son; and personality is designed and bestowed by the Universal Father alone. The text adds that mind is the endowment of the Third Source and Center, and that spiritual design is ultimately controlled by the Trinity. Even a Creator Son who seems all-powerful in his universe works in co-operation with the three persons of Deity, showing that universe creation is a partnership of the Gods rather than the act of one being.

L068.t: Seven Stages of the Sovereignty of a Creator Son
rows: Solitary provisional authority before the Creative Spirit acquires personal qualities
Joint rule of the Paradise pair after the Mother Spirit's personality achievement
Advancing authority during the seven creature bestowals
Settled authority following the completion of the seventh bestowal
Advanced relationship as a majority of domains settle in light and life
Exercised after the entire local universe is settled in light and life
The unknown relationships of a future universe age
L068.d: The sovereignty of a Creator Son is not given complete at the outset but passes through six, perhaps seven, stages of experiential manifestation. At first he exercises solitary provisional authority; after the Creative Spirit attains personality the pair rule jointly; and his authority grows through the seven creature bestowals. Upon completion of the seventh bestowal supreme sovereignty is established. In Nebadon it dates from Michael's bestowal on Urantia and has existed just slightly over nineteen hundred years. Thereafter sovereignty is augmented as the worlds settle in light and life, becomes Trinitarian when the entire universe is settled, and beyond that remains unrevealed. Because the earth life of Jesus completed the establishment of our universe sovereignty, the list reminds us of Urantia's place in universe history.

L069.t: Seven Experiential Steps to Supreme Sovereignty
rows: To penetrate seven creature levels of being through incarnated bestowal
To make an experiential consecration to each phase of the sevenfold will of Paradise Deity
To traverse each creature experience simultaneously with one of the seven consecrations
On each creature level, to portray the acme of creature life to Paradise Deity
On each creature level, to reveal one phase of the sevenfold will of Deity
To unify the sevenfold creature experience with the sevenfold experience of consecration
To achieve new and higher relationship with the Supreme Being
L069.d: To obtain supreme sovereignty over a local universe, a Creator Son must pass through seven experiential steps. Seven times he incarnates in the very likeness of his creatures, penetrating each level of being, and each time he consecrates himself to one phase of the sevenfold will of Deity as personified in the Seven Master Spirits. In each bestowal he portrays the acme of creature life upward to Deity and reveals the will of Deity downward to the universe. When these two strands of experience are unified, the repercussion augments the reality of God the Supreme and factualizes Michael's supreme sovereignty. The heart of the list is that the right to rule is not merely conferred from above but earned by living the lives of those who are ruled. The life of Jesus, the seventh bestowal, is thus seen in cosmic perspective.

L070.t: Three Reasons the Sovereignty of a Sevenfold Creator Son Is Supreme
rows: Embraces the sevenfold viewpoint of Paradise Deity
Embodies a sevenfold attitude of time-space creatures
Perfectly synthesizes Paradise attitude and creature viewpoint
L070.d: The power of a Master Michael is unlimited because it derives from experienced association with the Paradise Trinity, and unquestioned because it derives from actual experience as the very creatures subject to his authority. The supremacy of his sovereignty rests on three points: it embraces the sevenfold viewpoint of Deity, embodies the sevenfold attitude of creatures, and perfectly synthesizes the two. The view from above and the experience from below meet in one personality. The text adds that this experiential sovereignty is all-inclusive of the divinity of God the Sevenfold culminating in the Supreme Being, and resembles the future sovereignty of the sometime-to-be-completed Supreme. The idea of a ruler who knows both God's viewpoint and man's shows why Jesus is the rightful sovereign of our universe.

L071.t: Three Primary Divisions of the Trinitized Sons of God
L071.d: Besides the descending and ascending orders of sonship there is a third group, the Trinitized Sons of God, subdivided by the origins of its personalities into three primary divisions: Deity-trinitized Sons, Trinity-embraced Sons, and Creature-trinitized Sons. Whatever their origin, all have in common the experience of trinitization, either as part of their origin or as an experience of Trinity embrace subsequently attained. Since the Deity-trinitized Sons are unrevealed in these narratives, the presentation confines itself to the other two groups, more particularly the Trinity-embraced sons. Because ascendant mortals themselves may be embraced by the Trinity and enter this group, the classification offers an early glimpse of one of the distant possibilities of human ascension.

L072.t: The Seven Orders of Trinity-Embraced Sons
L072.d: All Trinity-embraced sons are originally of dual or single origin, but after the Trinity embrace they are forever devoted to Trinity service. Organized for superuniverse service, the corps embraces seven orders. The first three are Adjuster-fused mortals who have attained Paradise; the next two are recruited from evolutionary seraphim, translated midwayers, and Spirit-fused and Son-fused mortals; and the last two are unique twice-trinitized personalities. Whereas Trinity-origin associates are of stationary numbers, these sons are constantly increasing; they serve the seven superuniverses in exactly equal numbers, and not one has ever been lost. Since a mortal of Urantia may one day become a Mighty Messenger serving beside the Ancients of Days, the list opens a remarkable horizon of ascension.

L073.t: Three Major Divisions of the Trinity-Embraced Sons
rows: Mighty Messengers, Those High in Authority, Those without Name and Number
L073.d: The seven orders of Trinity-embraced sons are further classified, according to origin, nature, and function, into three major divisions. The Sons of Attainment are Adjuster-fused ascendant mortals who have attained Paradise and the Corps of the Finality; when Trinity embraced, their names are removed from the finaliter roll call. The Sons of Selection are recruited from evolutionary seraphim and translated midway creatures who have traversed Havona, and from Spirit-fused and Son-fused mortals. The Sons of Perfection are the creature-trinitized sons of Paradise-Havona personalities or of long-distinguished ascendant mortals, a unique group of twice-trinitized personalities. Through the three names, attainment, selection, and perfection, the classification shows beings who came by very different paths gathered into the same Trinity service.

rows: Conceptual realities of the Almighty Supreme acquired by finaliters
High spiritual aspects of the Supreme Being acquired by Paradise Citizens and Havoners
Actualities of Supreme-Ultimate Deity from a finaliter and a Paradise-Havoner together
L074.d: The Supreme Being is the unification of three phases of Deity reality: God the Supreme, the spiritual unification of finite aspects of the Trinity; the Almighty Supreme, the power unification of the grand universe Creators; and the Supreme Mind, the contribution of the Third Source and Center. In their trinitization adventures the superb creatures of the central universe and Paradise take part in revealing this Deity of the Supreme. Finaliters trinitize conceptual realities of the Almighty Supreme gained in their ascent through time and space; Paradise Citizens and Havoners trinitize spiritual aspects of the Supreme acquired on a background bordering on the Ultimate. When the two trinitize together, the effort repercusses in the Supreme-Ultimate Mind, and supercreational Sons of Destiny result. The deeper meaning is that even creature creativity contributes to the growth of the Supreme.

L075.t: Seven Divisions of Service of the Solitary Messengers
rows: Ambassadors and Emissaries of Special Assignment
L075.d: Solitary Messengers are assigned by the Infinite Spirit to seven divisions of service. The list begins with the Paradise Trinity and descends through Havona, the superuniverses, and the local universes, then turns to explorers of undirected assignment, ambassadors and emissaries of special assignment, and finally the revelators of truth.
