Yet these are not separate orders. Solitary Messengers are spiritually alike and in every sense equal, and transfers from one service to another are constantly taking place. The Infinite Spirit knows each by a personal name, while others know them by the name or number of their current assignment. Messengers of the Trinity are the trusted and secret servants of the Deities and have never betrayed a confidence. That revelators of truth close the list suggests their connection with revelations such as this one.

L076.t: Seven Divisions of the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit
rows: Personal Aids of the Infinite Spirit
L076.d: This list arranges the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit who function throughout the grand universe into seven divisions. The first four, Solitary Messengers, Circuit Supervisors, Census Directors, and Personal Aids, are characterized by tremendous endowments of antigravity. Solitary Messengers roam the universe of universes without known headquarters; Circuit Supervisors and Census Directors are based on the superuniverse capitals; the Personal Aids are stationed on the central Isle of Light. Associate Inspectors and Assigned Sentinels serve in the local universes and systems, and Graduate Guides lead ascenders through Havona. Supervising circuits, counting beings, inspecting, guarding, and guiding are all part of the unseen administration that keeps the universe orderly. The list shows how variously the family of the Infinite Spirit cares for creation.

L077.t: Four Orders of Universe Circuit Supervisors
L077.d: Universe Circuit Supervisors are the exclusive creation of the Infinite Spirit, and they function solely as agents of the Conjoint Actor. They are personalized in four orders that follow the structure of the universes. The seven supreme supervisors are stationed on the pilot worlds of the seven Havona circuits; the seven associate supervisors keep headquarters on the seven Paradise spheres of the Infinite Spirit and have charge of the circuits of the seven superuniverses; secondary supervisors serve at superuniverse headquarters, and tertiary supervisors at local universe headquarters. The first two orders are of completed numbers. In liaison with the Supreme Power Centers, they co-ordinate all material and spiritual circuits passing out to the seven superuniverses. They are, in a sense, the overseers of the pathways along which spirit flows.

L078.t: Seven Orders of the Messenger Hosts of Space
L078.d: The Messenger Hosts of Space rank intermediately in the family of the Infinite Spirit and serve as versatile connecting links between the higher personalities and the ministering spirits. Of the seven groups only three, the servitals, the conciliators, and the Morontia Companions, are created as such; the remaining four, the Technical Advisers, Custodians of Records, Celestial Recorders, and Paradise Companions, represent attainment levels of the angelic orders. The list thus mixes offices given by creation with offices reached by attainment. According to nature and status, these beings serve throughout the universe of universes, always subject to the direction of those who rule their realms. Adjusting disputes, giving technical counsel, preserving records, and accompanying ascenders are careful services that make the ascension journey actually possible.

rows: Unanimously designated by the other three as judicial head of the group
Presents evidence and safeguards the rights of all personalities involved
Contacts material beings and executes the decisions of the commission
The clerk of the tribunal, preparing all records
L079.d: In each superuniverse the Universal Conciliators find themselves strangely and innately segregated into groups of four, associations in which they continue to serve. Three are spirit personalities, and one is a semimaterial being. The judge-arbiter, unanimously chosen by the other three, heads the group; the spirit-advocate he appoints presents evidence and safeguards the rights of all concerned. The divine executioner, a fourth creature, contacts material beings and executes the decisions, being almost visible to mortal sight. The remaining member automatically becomes the recorder, preparing records for the superuniverse and the local universe. Because the advocate is detached during adjudication, these commissions are sometimes called referee trios. With judgment, advocacy, execution, and record all provided for, the quartet presents a heavenly pattern of fair adjudication.

L080.t: Seven Levels of Universe Service by Conciliators
rows: Conciliators to the Superuniverse Minor Sectors
Conciliators to the Superuniverse Major Sectors
L080.d: The order of conciliators is wholly dependable; not one has ever gone astray. They take origin on a superuniverse headquarters, go out to the individual worlds, and return through seven levels of service. On the worlds they settle deadlocked matters among supervising personalities; in systems and constellations they adjust group contentions and misunderstandings between different orders of creatures; and as they advance through local universes and superuniverse sectors there is less misunderstanding to adjudicate and more mysterious phenomena to explain. The divine executioner gradually loses his material duties and becomes a mercy-justice interpreter. At the last level the four become co-ordinate arbiter-teachers. Behind the list lies a simple truth: wherever there are beings with the power of choice, misunderstandings arise, and provision must be made for their fair adjustment.

L081.t: Seven Orders from Which Technical Advisers Are Recruited
L081.d: Technical Advisers are not created as such; they are recruited from the ranks of several personality orders. The list begins with the supernaphim of the central universe, passes through the seconaphim, tertiaphim, and omniaphim of the superuniverses, descends to the seraphim of the local universes, and finally includes certain types of ascending mortals and ascending midwayers. It is notable that not only angels but also creatures risen from the evolutionary worlds share in this work of legal and technical counsel. The text reports that, not counting mortals and midwayers of transient attachment, the Technical Advisers operating in Orvonton number slightly in excess of sixty-one trillion. Universe administration is thus aided by countless advisers versed in rules and procedures, and mortals may take part in that work during their ascent.

L082.t: Seven Classifications of the Ministering Spirits of the Grand Universe
L082.d: The ministering spirits of the grand universe fall into seven classifications: the supernaphim of the central universe; the seconaphim, tertiaphim, and omniaphim of the superuniverses; the seraphim of the local universes with their assistants, the cherubim and sanobim; and the midway creatures born on the inhabited worlds. The order runs from Paradise down to the worlds where mortals live. The text adds that individual members of the angelic orders are not altogether stationary as to personal status. Some become Paradise Companions for a season, others Celestial Recorders or Technical Advisers; certain cherubim may aspire to seraphic status, and evolutionary seraphim can achieve the spiritual levels of the ascending Sons of God. The quiet message of the list is that angels, too, grow and ascend.

L083.t: Three Groupings of Ministering Spirits by Importance to Ascenders
rows: The Ministering Spirits of the Central Universe
The Ministering Spirits of the Superuniverses
The seconaphim, the tertiaphim, and the omniaphim
The Ministering Spirits of the Local Universes
The seraphim and their assistants, the cherubim
L083.d: The seven orders of ministering spirits are grouped for presentation according to their functions of greatest importance to ascending creatures. In the central universe the three orders of supernaphim serve the Paradise-Havona system; in the superuniverses the seconaphim, tertiaphim, and omniaphim minister; in the local universes the seraphim and cherubim serve. Mortal ascenders have initial contact with the seraphim, offspring of a Universe Mother Spirit. The midway creatures, native to the inhabited worlds, are functionally grouped with these spirits but are not really of the angelic orders proper. The text notes that it is especially the supernaphim, seconaphim, and seraphim who, in large numbers, further the ascending scheme for the children of time, forming an unbroken chain of spirit ministers from the evolutionary worlds to Paradise.

L084.t: Seven Assignments of the Corps of Tertiary Supernaphim
rows: To maintain system and to insure harmony
The broadcast receivers and senders of the central creation
Bearers of all messages requiring personal transmission
Promoters of fraternal association between ascending and descending pilgrims
Take away the disappointed candidates who transiently fail
Reserves of supernaphim on the pilot world of the seventh circle
L084.d: The tertiary supernaphim are the angels chiefly assigned in Havona to the service of the pilgrims of time, and they work in seven groups, each taking origin from one of the Spirits of the Havona circuits. Harmony supervisors provide the co-ordination required even in perfect Havona; chief recorders write in triplicate for Havona, for their order, and for Paradise. Broadcasters receive and send the news of the central creation, messengers carry all communications requiring personal transmission, and intelligence co-ordinators foster fraternal association between ascending and descending pilgrims. Transport personalities take away candidates who transiently fail in the Deity adventure, and the reserve corps stands ready for any assignment. It is touching that provision is made even for the pilgrims who temporarily fail.

L085.t: Seven Working Groups of Secondary Supernaphim
L085.d: Secondary supernaphim minister to the seven planetary circuits of the central universe, and in serving the ascending pilgrims they work in seven groups. Their order traces the pilgrim's path from the outer to the inner circuit of Havona. Pilgrim helpers receive the newcomers, Supremacy guides help them comprehend God the Supreme, and Trinity guides lead them to the concept of the Trinity. Son finders and Father guides then assist in the discovery of the Eternal Son and the Universal Father, while counselors and advisers and the complements of rest attend to the final preparation. Each group contains angels of all seven created types, and a pilgrim is always tutored by supernaphim of origin in the Master Spirit who presides over his superuniverse of nativity. Mortals of Urantia will thus be piloted by angels reflecting the Seventh Master Spirit.

L086.t: Seven Orders of Service of the Primary Supernaphim
L086.d: The primary supernaphim have served on the Isle of Light from eternity, but they have functioned as now classified only since the arrival on Paradise of the Havona pilgrims of time. These high angels minister in seven orders of service. Notably, ascending pilgrims pass through their training under these angels in the reverse order of the naming once they actually attain Paradise residence. They begin their Paradise career under the instigators of rest and advance through the chiefs of assignment, interpreters of ethics, directors of conduct, custodians of knowledge, and masters of philosophy, coming at last to the conductors of worship. This sequence, beginning with rest and ending with worship, shows that the summit of Paradise life is not knowledge or philosophy but the worship of God.

L087.t: Three Orders of Ministering Spirits of the Superuniverses
L087.d: The ministering spirits of the superuniverses, as presented in these narratives, embrace the seconaphim, the tertiaphim, and the omniaphim. Yet the text notes that, technically, neither tertiaphim nor omniaphim are ministering spirits of the superuniverses, though both serve as spirit ministers in these domains. Tertiaphim, children of the Infinite Spirit, serve the liaison between Creator Sons and Ancients of Days, while omniaphim serve the Supreme Executives exclusively. Since these two orders are not so directly concerned with the ascendant scheme of mortal progression, they are treated briefly, and the main attention falls on the seconaphim, offspring of the Reflective Spirits. Seconaphim serve as living reflective mechanisms in nearly every affair of the supergovernments and are closely related to ascending mortals. The short list illustrates how the revelation gives weight to what matters most for ascenders.

L088.t: Seven Types of Service of the Primary Seconaphim
rows: The Voice of the Conjoint Actor
The Voice of the Seven Master Spirits
The Voice of the Creator Sons
The Voice of the Angelic Hosts
L088.d: The primary seconaphim incline by inherent nature toward seven types of service, and they are created serially, so that the first and every seventh one thereafter share the same type. The first four are voices: they reflect to the Ancients of Days the mind of the Infinite Spirit, the collective natures of the Seven Master Spirits, the minds of the Creator Sons, and the sentiments of all orders of angels. Thus the superuniverse rulers, though apparently deprived of the personal presence of the Master Spirits above and the Michaels below, can know their attitudes at once and deduce the Father's will by equating the voices from above and below. The other three receive special broadcasts, carry pilgrims to Havona, and stand in reserve for emergencies. The revelators admit they do not fully understand how this works, but testify that it unfailingly does.

L089.t: Seven Reflective Types of Secondary Seconaphim
L089.d: The seven reflective types of secondary seconaphim are assigned to the three co-ordinate Trinity-origin associates of the Ancients of Days. To the Perfectors of Wisdom go the Voices of Wisdom, the Souls of Philosophy, and the Unions of Souls; to the Divine Counselors, the Hearts of Counsel, the Joys of Existence, and the Satisfactions of Service; and to the Universal Censors, the Discerners of Spirits. The Voices of Wisdom are in perpetual liaison with the living libraries of Paradise and reflect the co-ordinated wisdom of the universes, while the Discerners of Spirits help the Censors judge the authenticity of what comes from realms where rebellion has been rife. Their very names carry virtues: wisdom, philosophy, ethical union, counsel, joy, satisfaction, and discernment. The list shows that superuniverse government runs not by law and power alone but in a spirit of wisdom, joy, and service.

L090.d: Tertiary seconaphim are likewise created serially in seven reflective types, but they are not assigned individually; all are collectively assigned to the Trinitized Sons of Attainment. Their names read like a sequence of lessons for ascending creatures. The Significances of Origins are living genealogies of all beings; the Memory of Mercy is the living record of mercy extended to each individual, read into testimony when one's right to unending life is adjudicated. The Import of Time reminds that time is the one talent intrusted to all will creatures, and the Solemnity of Trust declares trustworthiness the true measure of character. Once trustworthiness is discovered, the privilege of service follows, and finally the Secret of Greatness and the Soul of Goodness teach that greatness and goodness are inseparable in God. To be great is to be Godlike.

L091.t: Three Groups of Living Beings Having to Do with Force Control and Energy Regulation
L091.d: Mankind has long known of angels, but little information concerning the controllers and regulators of the physical domain has ever been imparted. The revelator names three groups of living beings having to do with force control and energy regulation in the master universe, and is permitted fully to disclose only the last. The first two, the Master Force Organizers, deal with the primordial force of space, and their eventuated and transcendental origins place them beyond the categories of time and space. The third group, the Universe Power Directors, regulate energy intelligently throughout the grand universe and become the subject of the following narrative. The heart of the list is that even the physical order of the cosmos is under the intelligent supervision of living beings. Behind the laws of the material world stand mind and will.

L092.t: Four Major Divisions of the Universe Power Directors
L092.d: The revelator deems it impossible to portray the individuality of the directors, centers, and controllers of universe power, but hopes to explain something of their domain. They are a unique group of living beings having to do with the intelligent regulation of energy throughout the grand universe, embracing four major divisions: the Seven Supreme Power Directors, personalized by the Seven Master Spirits; the Supreme Power Centers, produced by the directors together with the Master Spirits; the Master Physical Controllers, offspring of the centers; and the Morontia Power Supervisors. The supreme directors and centers have existed from the near times of eternity, and no more have been created. The list follows a lineage from spirit parents to semimaterial progeny, revealing an order of beings bridging spirit and matter. Hard as they are for mortals to envisage, every flow of universe energy passes through their hands.

L093.t: Seven Groups of Supreme Power Centers
L093.d: The Seven Supreme Power Directors cannot reproduce themselves individually, but collectively, and in association with the Seven Master Spirits, they create other beings like themselves. Such is the origin of the Supreme Power Centers, who function in seven groups. The list begins with the Supreme Center Supervisors, regulators of the master energy circuits of the grand universe, and descends through Havona, the superuniverses, the local universes, the constellations, and the systems, ending with unclassified centers of special assignment. The sequence matches the levels of universe administration. These centers are endowed with Third-Source personality, disclose high volitional capacity, and direct the energy system with exquisite intelligence. The list shows that even the flow of physical energy is watched and regulated by personal beings at every level of the universe.

L094.t: Seven Orders of Master Physical Controllers, Offspring of the Supreme Power Centers
L094.d: The Master Physical Controllers are the direct offspring of the Supreme Power Centers, and they form seven orders. The list moves from power direction and mechanical control to the transformation and transmission of energy, then to the association and dissociation of matter, ending with the Frandalanks and Chronoldeks, living instruments that register energy and time. The text notes that not all of these orders are persons in the sense of possessing individual powers of choice. The last four especially seem wholly automatic and mechanical in response to their superiors and to energy conditions, yet their response is not actually mechanistic. It adds that personality is not necessarily a concomitant of mind, for mind can think even when deprived of all power of choice. The list invites reflection on the subtle distinctions among personality, mind, and automatic response.

L095.t: Two Grand Divisions of the Master Force Organizers
rows: Nebulae creators; transmute primordial force into primary or puissant energy
Continue energy transmutation through the secondary or gravity-energy stage
L095.d: The force organizers are resident on Paradise but function throughout the master universe, especially in the domains of unorganized space. They are neither creators nor creatures, and they work exclusively under the supervision of the Architects of the Master Universe. The two divisions share one continuous process. The primary organizers transmute primordial force, held only by the Unqualified Absolute, into energy responsive to Paradise gravity, instigating the energy cyclones of space; the associate organizers carry that energy on to the gravity-energy stage. When a Creator Son arrives and the plans for a local universe are complete, they give way to the power directors of the superuniverse. The list shows that a material universe is born not by chance but as the planned work of living beings.

L096.t: The Paradise Classification of Living Beings
rows: The Supreme Spirits, the Stationary Sons of the Trinity, Trinity-origin and Trinitized Beings
The Descending Orders, the Stationary Orders, the Ascending Orders
The Supreme Spirits, the Ascending Orders, the Family of the Infinite Spirit
Architects of the Master Universe, Transcendental Recorders, other Transcendentalers, Master Force Organizers
Best typified by the Thought Adjusters, fragments of the First Source and Center
Other-than-personal beings of divine origin and of manifold service
The Consummator of Universe Destiny, Majeston of Paradise, the Midsonite Orders, and others
L096.d: Paper 30 presents the personalities of the grand universe in two ways, and the first is the Paradise classification. On Paradise, living beings are classified by their inherent and attained relationship to the Paradise Deities. Beings originating in all three Deities, in any two, or in any one form the first three categories, each subdivided into descending, stationary, ascending, and other orders, unfolding into more than thirty lists. Then follow the eventuated Transcendentalers, who are neither creators nor creatures, the fragmented entities of Deity typified by the Adjusters, superpersonal beings, and orders yet unclassified. The revelators state at the outset that not all groups are revealed, for overrevelation stifles imagination. The classification teaches us to understand every being by its relationship of origin to Deity.

L097.t: Six Groups of Glorified Beings in the Primary Finaliter Corps
L097.d: The Corps of Mortal Finaliters is the present known destination of the ascending Adjuster-fused mortals of time, yet mortals are not its only members. Havona natives, Gravity Messengers, glorified mortals, adopted seraphim, glorified Material Sons, and glorified midway creatures together compose this unique body of eternal destiny. All are received in equality, but this exalted equality in no way abrogates individuality or destroys personal identity. The finaliters are now a wholly self-governing body, choosing their own leaders, and their oath of allegiance is only to the Paradise Trinity. The list shows how beings of very different origins become one corps through the associative experience of the long and eventful ascendant career, and together await their unknown service in outer space.

L098.t: Three Facts Pointing to One More Step in the Finaliter Career
rows: Mortals attain the sixth stage of spirit existence upon taking the finaliter oath
They have achieved the present limit of creature perfection but not finality of creature service
They have been trained respecting every divine principle of the administration of all the universal creation
L098.d: Mortal finaliters attain Paradise, are mustered into the Corps of the Finality, and are sent back to assist in local and superuniverse affairs, yet they are of record as only sixth-stage spirits. The Uversa author frankly admits ignorance of the next step but calls attention to three facts. Spirit classification has always followed actual advancement from one realm of service to another; the finaliters have reached the present limit of perfection but not finality; and they have been thoroughly trained in every principle of universe administration. The author surmises that seventh-spirit classification will come with service on unrevealed spheres and the attainment of God the Supreme. He then shares with the reader the question: Why should the Gods so thoroughly train surviving mortals in the technique of universe management?

L099.t: Seven Levels of the Master Architects
rows: The senior Architect; co-ordinator of Paradise and its twenty-one worlds
Three; co-ordination of the one billion perfect spheres of the central universe
Seven; the superco-ordinators of the grand universe
Seventy; the first universe of outer space
490; the second universe of outer space
3,430; the third universe of outer space
24,010; the fourth and last universe of outer space
L099.d: The Architects of the Master Universe are the governing corps of the Paradise Transcendentalers, and their origin, nature, and destiny may not be fully revealed. Still, the revelators tell us that they exist in seven levels of the absonite. Their numbers grow from one, three, and seven to seventy, 490, 3,430, and 24,010, a total of 28,011. The upper three levels serve Paradise, Havona, and the grand universe; the lower four are conjectured to be concerned with the four universes now mobilizing in outer space. Numbers multiplying by seven suggest ever-increasing-sized universes to come. The Paradise tradition that the attempted 28,012th Architect experienced personality seizure by the Universal Absolute suggests that even absonity has its limit.

L100.t: The Seven Corps of the Finality
rows: The Corps of Conjoint Trinitized Finaliters
The Corps of Unrevealed Sons of Destiny
L100.d: The senior Master Architect has the oversight of the seven Corps of the Finality. The list begins with the Corps of Mortal Finaliters, passes through the Paradise, Trinitized, Conjoint Trinitized, Havona, and Transcendental Finaliters, and ends with the Unrevealed Sons of Destiny. The seven presiding heads constitute the Supreme Council of Destiny on Paradise, and in the present universe age Grandfanda, the first mortal ascender, is its chief. The revelators see nothing like this mobilization since the Paradise Trinity commissioned the rulers of the seven superuniverses in the near times of eternity. The Ultimate Trinity is probably mustering the forces of the finite and the absonite for inconceivable developments in outer space. It is remarkable that mortals of animal origin stand first in this list.

L101.t: Three Things Certain About the Outer Creations
rows: A vast and new system of universes is gradually organizing in the domains of outer space
The mysterious Paradise mobilization of the perfected and ascendant beings continues, with the six other finaliter corps
The Supreme Person of Deity is powerizing as the almighty sovereign of the supercreations
L101.d: The Uversa authors confess that they really know nothing about the plans of the Master Architects for the outer creations, yet of three things they are certain. The first concerns universes, the second creatures, and the third Deity. Gigantic universes are organizing in outer space and are visible through telescopes; the finaliter corps have been mobilizing on Paradise for ages upon ages; and the Supreme Being is powerizing as almighty sovereign. Viewing this triune development, the authors anticipate that something new and unrevealed is approaching culmination in the master universe. At least seventy thousand aggregations of matter have already been identified, each greater than any present superuniverse. The point of the list is that the destiny of ascending mortals is bound up with this vast future.

L102.t: Three Distinct Spirit Circuits in the Local Universe
rows: The bestowal spirit of the Creator Son, the Comforter, the Spirit of Truth
The spirit circuit of the Divine Minister, the Holy Spirit
The intelligence-ministry circuit, including the seven adjutant mind-spirits
L102.d: There are three distinct spirit circuits in the local universe of Nebadon. The first is the Spirit of Truth, poured out upon a world by a bestowal Son after he receives spiritual title to that sphere; it draws all truth seekers towards him who is the personification of truth. The second is the Holy Spirit of the Divine Minister, the Universe Mother Spirit, and the third is the intelligence-ministry circuit of the seven adjutant mind-spirits she creates. Notice that the Creator Son may come and go while the Spirit of Truth functions undisturbed, for this presence, though derived from the Son, is functionally centered in the Divine Minister, who never leaves Salvington. Thus the spirit of the Son, the presence of the Mother Spirit, and the adjutants of mind all minister together to the human mind.

L103.t: Four Orders of Local Universe Sonship
L103.d: The Sons considered here are of local universe origin rather than Paradise origin. They are the offspring of a Paradise Creator Son in varied association with the complemental Universe Mother Spirit. As triune Paradise Deity creates three orders of sonship, the Michaels, the Avonals, and the Daynals, so dual Deity in the local universe, the Son and the Spirit, creates three high orders: the Melchizedeks, the Vorondadeks, and the Lanonandeks. Having achieved this threefold expression, they collaborate with the next level of God the Sevenfold to produce the versatile Life Carriers. These are classed as descending Sons of God, yet they are a unique and original form of universe life. The structure is striking: the threefold creation of Paradise is repeated on a lower level, and a fourth order devoted to life is added.

L104.t: The Seven Melchizedek Worlds of the Salvington Circuit
rows: The pilot world—the home world of the Melchizedek Sons
The world of the physical-life schools and the laboratories of living energies
The sphere of initial spirit life
The sphere of advancing spirit life
The domain of co-ordinate and supreme self-realization
L104.d: The 490 spheres of the Salvington circuit are divided into ten groups, each with seven primary and forty-two tributary spheres. The first group is these seven worlds under the supervision of the Melchizedeks. Their order moves from physical life to morontia life, then through initial, mid-, and advancing spirit life to supreme self-realization, so that the whole course of the ascendant career is mirrored in their arrangement. The pilot world, the sphere Melchizedek, is the common meeting ground for all beings who educate and spiritualize ascending mortals, and every mortal who graduates from constellation training lands there. The author says that even after reaching Paradise you will never forget your first day on this unique world. The list shows universe education beginning systematically in the hands of the Melchizedeks.

L105.t: Six Tributary Spheres of Study Around Melchizedek
rows: The review of the initial planetary life of the ascending mortals
A similar review of the experiences on the mansion worlds
Reviews of the sojourn on the capital of the local system
A review of the experiences of the seventy tributary worlds of the constellation
The review of the ascendant sojourn on the constellation headquarters world
Correlating these five epochs to achieve co-ordination of experience
L105.d: On the six tributary worlds around the pilot world Melchizedek, ascending mortals look back on the road they have traveled before learning anything new. On the first sphere they review their planetary life in classes made up of those from the same world, and those from Urantia pursue this review together. They then review in turn the mansion worlds, the system capital, the seventy tributary worlds of the constellation, and the constellation headquarters. On the sixth sphere they correlate these five epochs into a co-ordinated whole, and only then enter the Melchizedek primary schools. The arrangement shows that universe education does not discard past experience but builds upon it and integrates it. Every stage traveled becomes the foundation of further progress.

rows: 709,841; System Sovereigns, assistants to constellation councils, counselors
10,234,601; Planetary Princes and the reserves of that order
1,055,558; subordinate assistants, messengers, custodians, commissioners, observers
L106.d: The Lanonandeks, the third order of universe sonship born of the Creator Son and the Universe Mother Spirit, are best known as System Sovereigns and Planetary Princes. Nebadon began with exactly twelve million of them, and as the first students of the Melchizedek University they were divided by final tests into three classes according to ability, personality, and attainment. The highest, the primary, rule systems and assist in constellation administration; the most numerous, the secondary, become Planetary Princes of inhabited worlds; the tertiary carry the miscellaneous duties of a system. Unlike evolutionary beings, they cannot progress from one group to another, nor do they reproduce. Drawing nearer the lower creatures, they render greater service in the subordinate units of the universe but stand in greater danger of going astray, which is why this list matters for understanding the history of rebellion.

L107.t: The Lanonandek Order as Classified on Salvington
L107.d: Unlike the three classes determined by the Melchizedek tests, this list gives the round numbers by which Salvington classifies the Lanonandeks according to actual service. Of the twelve million, ten million belong to the Planetary Princes and their reserves, for every inhabited world needs a prince and every vacancy must be filled. Universe Co-ordinators, Constellation Counselors, System Sovereigns, and assistants form the upper ranks; the Messenger Corps and the custodians and recorders handle liaison and preservation; and a Reserve Corps of eight hundred thousand stands behind them. When System Sovereigns or assistants are recalled, the supreme council of the constellation fills their places from the reserves, a group larger on Edentia than the average. These numbers show a local universe administration run with ample reserves, where system governments do not suddenly change unless tragedy occurs.

L108.t: The Seven Worlds of the Life Carriers
rows: The sphere of life associated with mind
The sphere of mind and spirit in living beings
L108.d: The fourth group of primary spheres in the Salvington circuit are the worlds of the Life Carriers, under the general oversight of the Melchizedeks. The seven begin with the headquarters and proceed through life planning, conservation, and evolution to life associated with mind and to mind and spirit in living beings, ending with the sphere of unrevealed life. The order traces how life is designed, conserved, and evolved until it finally harbors mind and spirit. Each primary sphere is surrounded by six satellites devoted to special phases of Life Carrier activity. On the headquarters world is the college of life planning, where teachers from Uversa, Havona, and even Paradise function, and there too are the central emplacements of the seven adjutant mind-spirits. Notice also that the domain of life is characterized not by ten but by three, seven, and twelve.

rows: Quick perception, the primitive physical and inherent reflex instincts
The impulse of co-ordination, the spontaneous association of ideas
The fidelity endowment, the basis of character acquirement
The curiosity-mother of adventure and discovery, the scientific spirit
The social urge, the endowment of species co-operation
The religious impulse, the badge of spiritual-ascension candidacy
The inherent tendency towards orderly and progressive evolutionary advancement
L109.d: The seven adjutant mind-spirits, created by the local universe Mother Spirit, are ministers of the lower levels of experiential mind. This list arranges them in the order of evolutionary attainment, rising from intuition through understanding, courage, knowledge, and counsel to worship and wisdom. The first five function also in the animal orders, and this animal relationship makes the adjutants more practically effective as human mind. The sixth, the spirit of worship, is the first differential urge separating mind creatures into the two basic classes of mortal existence, forever distinguishing its associated animal from the soulless creatures. The seventh, the spirit of wisdom, is the highest, co-ordinating the work of all the others. The adjutants grow experientially but never become personal. Human intellect, the list shows, is worship and wisdom added to a foundation shared with the animals.

L110.d: The Universe Aids assist in local universe administration, and many of the unique orders in this category are unrevealed. The seven presented here begin with the Bright and Morning Star and end with the Mansion World Teachers. There is just one Bright and Morning Star in each local universe, the first-born of all its native creatures; in ours he is Gabriel of Salvington, chief executive of all Nebadon, representing the Sovereign Son and speaking for his creative consort. The Brilliant Evening Stars, planned by the Melchizedeks, serve chiefly as Gabriel's liaison officers and represent him at the capital of every constellation and system. The remaining orders share various phases of universe administration and the education of ascending mortals. The list stretches from the summit of universe government to the ascender's first classroom.

L111.t: Four Created Types of Permanent Local Universe Citizens
rows: Salvington, the headquarters of the local universe
The one hundred constellation headquarters worlds
The system capitals; some commissioned as Planetary Adams
L111.d: Like the super- and central universes, the local universe has its orders of permanent citizenship. The four in this list descend through the levels of local universe administration: the susatia live on Salvington, the univitatia on the constellation headquarters worlds, the Material Sons on the system capitals, and the midway creatures on the evolutionary worlds. Together with the Spirit-fused ascenders and the spironga, they form a relatively permanent citizenship, by and large neither ascending nor descending, whose enlarging experience remains available to the universe on their level of origin. The univitatia do for ascending mortals in the constellations what the Havona natives do for pilgrims in the central creation. The midwayers are the only group of intelligent beings remaining continuously on a planet from the Planetary Prince to light and life; on Urantia they are the real custodians of the planet.

L112.t: Three Great Classes of Cherubim and Sanobim
rows: By nature candidates for seraphic status
The inherently limited beings of the angelic creations
“Fourth creatures” who always retain quasi-material characteristics
L112.d: Cherubim and sanobim are the angelic helpers of the seraphim, and this list divides them into three classes according to evolutionary potential. The ascension candidates are not by inherent endowment equal to the seraphim, but by application and experience they may attain full seraphic standing. The mid-phase cherubim are inherently limited, and most will remain cherubim and sanobim; the morontia cherubim always retain their quasi-material characteristics and continue in their service pending the completed factualization of the Supreme Being. After long service as Mansion World Teachers, ascension candidates are re-embraced by the Universe Mother Spirit and emerge as full seraphim, and may then attain Seraphington, Paradise, and even the Corps of the Finality. Angels too have paths of growth, opened to each according to its potential.

rows: Derived from the modified ascendant-mortal staffs of the Planetary Princes; always fifty thousand
Derived from the Adams and Eves or their immediate progeny; average around fifty thousand
L113.d: Midway creatures appear on the majority of inhabited worlds and are always found on the decimal or life-experiment planets, such as Urantia. The primary midwayers, the more spiritual group, resemble angels more than mortals; the secondary midwayers, the more material group, are much more like human beings. The primary derive from the staff of the Planetary Prince, the secondary from the planetary biologic uplifters, the Adams and Eves, by no less than twenty-four diverse techniques. Neither group is an evolutionary accident; both are essential features in the predetermined plans of the universe architects. The gap between the material and spiritual worlds is perfectly bridged by the serial association of mortal man, secondary midwayer, primary midwayer, morontia cherubim, mid-phase cherubim, and seraphim. The two midwayer groups are vital links in that bridge.

L114.d: The Infinite Spirit on the local universe headquarters intends to produce uniformly perfect seraphim, but for some unknown reason these seraphic offspring are very diverse. The revelator suggests this may result from the unknown interposition of evolving experiential Deity, yet cannot prove it. After educational tests and training, however, seraphim invariably fall into seven groups: supreme, superior, supervisor, and administrator seraphim, planetary helpers, transition ministers, and seraphim of the future. It would hardly be true to call any one group inferior to another, though every angel is at first service-limited to its original classification. Manotia, the supreme seraphim who helped prepare this paper, achieved all seven services one by one through effort and devoted service. The list shows that angels too are experiential creatures who can augment their inherent endowment.

rows: Serve the high Sons and Spirit-origin beings of the local universe
Attached to all orders of adjudication; defenders of mortals
Postgraduate counselors of ascenders pausing for the last time on Salvington
Secretaries to all orders of teachers
A body of 144 co-ordinating seraphic service and assignment
The official recorders for the supreme seraphim
Self-directed servers; the general reserve corps of this order
L115.d: The supreme seraphim are the highest of the seven revealed orders of local universe angels, functioning in seven groups closely associated with the angelic ministers of the Seraphic Corps of Completion. The list begins with the Son-Spirit Ministers, who serve the high Sons; among them, 144 bestowal attendants always accompany Paradise Avonals on bestowal missions. Then come the court advisers, who defend mortals in the tribunals; the universe orientators, friends of ascenders leaving their native universe; the teaching counselors, secretaries to the teachers; the directors of assignment; the recorders; and the unattached ministers. The description of the court advisers is especially moving: justice demands the adjudication of every default, but mercy requires that every such miss be judged fairly in accordance with creature nature. The highest angels thus stand on the side of mortals.

rows: Gabriel's personal staff, gathering the information of the realms
The real mercy ministers of the local universes
Prepare the ascendant sojourners on Salvington for their last local universe transition
Helpers of the teaching counselors; connected with the mansion world training
Space traversers to and from the local universe headquarters
Reception, filing, and redispatch of the records of Salvington
Held on Salvington, instantly available for dispatch to the farthermost worlds
L116.d: The superior seraphim, next below the supreme order, work for the whole local universe and are largely based on Salvington. The intelligence corps gather information for Gabriel; the Voice of Mercy fosters the higher impulses and holier emotions of men and angels. The spirit co-ordinators prepare ascenders on Salvington for the status of newly born spirit beings, and the assistant teachers aid the mansion world schools. Transporters, recorders, and reserves complete the list. The account of the transporters is of special interest: ascenders depend upon seraphic transport from world to world until the last sleep in Havona and the eternal awakening on Paradise, and being enseraphimed is not unlike the experience of death or sleep. The statement that mercy is the keynote of seraphic service runs through the whole list.

rows: The personal seraphim of the Planetary Adam and Eve
Foster racial harmony and social co-operation
Bring “⟦Q 39:5.5⟧peace on earth and good will among men⟦/Q⟧”
Inculcate trust in the evolving human mind
Custodians of the major affairs of the planet
Maintained on Jerusem; also personal message bearers of the local system
L117.d: The planetary helpers are seraphim headquartered on the system capitals and assigned primarily to the Planetary Adams, the biologic uplifters of the evolutionary worlds. The author notes that angelic ministry becomes more interesting as it nears the actual problems faced by the men and women of time. The first four groups deal with the inner life and society of man. The Voices of the Garden assist the Adamic plans; the Spirits of Brotherhood help races of different colors and natures toward harmony; the Souls of Peace bring peace to realms where peace is not the natural state; and the Spirits of Trust implant trust in primitive men whose inherent reaction is suspicion. Most were withdrawn from Urantia when the Adamic regime collapsed, yet these seraphim still labor here, and a civilization is now evolving which embodies much of their ideals of confidence and trust.

L118.t: Seven Orders of Assignment of Transition Ministers
L118.d: Seraphim of transitional ministry, as their name suggests, serve wherever they can contribute to creature transition from the material to the spiritual estate. They serve from the inhabited worlds to the system capitals, but in Satania they now direct their greatest efforts toward educating surviving mortals on the seven mansion worlds. The list divides this ministry into seven orders of assignment, beginning with seraphic evangels and racial interpreters, continuing through mind planners, morontia counselors, technicians, and recorder-teachers, with the ministering reserves standing behind them all. The names alone suggest a sequence of tasks: announcing the new life, interpreting racial backgrounds, planning and counseling the new morontia mind, and attending to environment and records. The author promises more in the narratives of the mansion worlds. The comfort of this list is that angels accompany the first steps after death.

L119.t: Three Most Important Ways Seraphim May Attain Paradise
rows: Perfection of specialized service as a celestial artisan, Technical Adviser, or Celestial Recorder
To attain Paradise by the evolutionary mortal technique, as guardian angels
L119.d: Seraphim may attain Paradise in scores, even hundreds, of ways, but the revelator names three as most important. The first is to gain admission to the Paradise seraphic abode in a personal capacity by achieving perfection of specialized service; the second is to be summoned to Seraphington from on high. Since no seraphic pair can initiate its own departure, these must patiently await the summons brought by tertiary supernaphim. The third is the evolutionary mortal technique, and the post of guardian angel is the supreme choice of seraphim in the career of time. Created a little higher than man, angels cannot start up from the very bottom, but they may go down to those who do and guide them, step by step and world by world, to the portals of Havona. It is beautiful that helping mortals determines the angels' own high destiny.

L120.t: Seven General Classes of the Ascending Sons of God
L120.d: Paper 40 deals with the ascending Sons and opens with this list. The first three are mortals, distinguished by the divine spirit with which they fuse: Father-fused, Son-fused, and Spirit-fused. Then come evolutionary seraphim, ascending Material Sons, translated midwayers, and the Personalized Adjusters of the Universal Father. The revelator calls the story of these beings a glorious recital of the unstinted bestowal of divine love and gracious condescension throughout all time and in all universes. The narrative began with the Deities and has descended the universal scale of living beings to the lowest order of life endowed with the potential of immortality; now an author who was once a mortal unfolds the path of ascent. It is remarkable that lowly animal-origin mortals and fragments of the Father belong to the same ascending series.

L121.t: Three Classifications of the Mortals of Time and Space
rows: Mortals of the transient or experiential Adjuster sojourn
L121.d: Spirit identification constitutes the secret of personal survival and determines the destiny of spiritual ascension. Since the Thought Adjusters are the only spirits of fusion potential to be identified with man during life in the flesh, the mortals of time and space are classified primarily by their relation to this indwelling Mystery Monitor. Series one are the primitive men of early epochs, as on pre-Adamic Urantia; an Adjuster remains throughout life but cannot form an eternal union, though it gains valuable experience and prepares its subject for later spirit fusion. Series two are specialized types, such as many nonbreathers, unable to unite with their Adjusters, and series three are mortals of Adjuster-fusion potential, like those of Urantia. Underlying the classification is the assurance that the Gods take note of man's status and needs at every stage and are always fair and merciful.

L122.t: Five Reasons Urantia Mortals Are Sons of God
rows: You are sons of spiritual promise, faith sons
A Creator Son of God became one of you
The spirit of a Son has been poured out upon you
The Universal Father has given you your creature personalities
There dwells within you a fragment of the Universal Father
L122.d: All evolutionary worlds harbor faith sons of God, sons of grace and mercy who belong to the divine family. This list gives five reasons Urantia mortals are entitled to regard themselves as sons of God. First, we have accepted the status of sonship and believe in its reality, and so our sonship becomes eternally real. Second, a Creator Son became one of us and is in fact our elder brother. Third, the spirit of that Son has been freely poured out upon all races. Fourth, the Father has given us personality, sharing with us a measure of the divine spontaneity of freewill action. Fifth, a fragment of the Father dwells within us. Faith, the bestowal of Jesus, the Spirit of Truth, personality, and the Adjuster are all gifts first given from God's side; that is the heart of this list.

L123.t: Seven Sources of Solar Energy in Order of Importance
rows: Annihilation of atoms and, eventually, of electrons
Transmutation of elements, including the radioactive group of energies
The accumulation and transmission of certain universal space-energies
Space matter and meteors incessantly diving into the blazing suns
Recaptive light and other matter, together with energies of extrasolar origin
L123.d: Paper 41 sets out, in order of importance, seven sources of the enormous energy that the suns pour forth. First comes the annihilation of atoms and eventually of electrons, followed by the transmutation of elements, the accumulation and transmission of space-energies, space matter and meteors diving into the suns, solar contraction, gravity action at high temperatures, and recaptive light together with energies of extrasolar origin. Underlying the whole list is the interchangeability of matter and energy. The text adds that only suns functioning in the direct channels of the main streams of universe energy can shine on forever; those far from such channels slowly cool and burn out, yet may be rejuvenated by collision or recharging. Suns too are pictured as blazing, cooling, and reviving within energy circuits, revealing the intricate cycles of the physical universe.

L124.t: Seven Systems of Force, Energy, and Power
rows: ABSOLUTA; the free space presence of the Unqualified Absolute
SEGREGATA; the first basic change in space potency
GRAVITA; directed by the power directors
TRIATA; the triune energy of the central universe
TRANOSTA; connected with the absonite peoples
The living, nonspirit energy of Paradise
L124.d: The author of Paper 42 proposes this classification of cosmic force, emergent energy, and universe power to lessen the conceptual confusion caused by loose use of the words force and energy. The list starts with space potency, the domain of the Unqualified Absolute, moves through primordial force, responsive to the presence of the primary force organizers, and the emergent energies, puissant and gravity, to universe power handled by the power directors. Thus far physical energy ripens in time and space. The narrative then continues Paradiseward to Havona energy, transcendental energy associated with the absonite peoples, and monota, the nonspiritual energy system of the Universal Father. The author confesses that Paradise spirit and Paradise monota cannot be differentiated in nature. Even physical energy, the list shows, has its source in the Father.

rows: The prime physical units of material existence
The explosive and repellent stage of the solar supergases
The electrical stage of material differentiation
Matter existing extensively in the interior of the hot suns
Found in the cooling suns and throughout space
Individual atoms stripped of their outer electrons
The chemical stage of elemental organization
Matter as it exists on Urantia in relatively stable materialization
The disorganizing tendency and activity of the heavier elements
The relatively stationary matter in the interior of the cold or dead suns
L125.d: The matter of the varied suns, planets, and space bodies falls into ten grand divisions. The list begins with ultimatonic matter, the energy particles that make up electrons, proceeds through subelectronic, electronic, and subatomic matter to shattered atoms, ionized matter, atomic matter, and the molecular stage, and ends with radioactive matter and the collapsed matter of dead suns. The author explains that this classification pertains to the organization of matter rather than to its appearance to created beings. The matter we handle is only the eighth stage, relatively stable under ordinary conditions. Immediately afterward comes the declaration that light, heat, electricity, magnetism, chemism, energy, and matter are in origin, nature, and destiny one and the same thing. Matter is seen not as fixed substance but as successive stages of energy organization.

L126.t: Ten Groups of Wavelike Energy Manifestations
rows: The borderland revolutions of ultimatons beginning to assume definite form
Vibrations occasioned by the assembly of energy into ultimatons
The shortest of all purely electronic vibrations
The basis of all materialization in the seven superuniverses
Emanations characterizing the spontaneous dissociation of atomic matter
Solar X rays together with artificially generated X rays
The chemical rays of sunlight and various mechanical productions
The whole visible light of the suns
The slowing down of electronic activity nearer the stage of appreciable heat
Energies utilized on Urantia for broadcasting
L126.d: This list classifies wavelike energy manifestations into ten groups from the standpoint of twentieth-century Urantia scientific enlightenment. It begins with the borderland revolutions of ultimatons as they assume definite form and passes through ultimatonic rays, short space rays, the electronic stage, gamma rays, X rays, ultraviolet rays, white light, and infrared rays to the Hertzian waves used for broadcasting. The arrangement descends from the shortest and most powerful waves to longer and slower ones. The author predicts that physicists will detect the phenomena of ultimatonic rays long before they discover the ultimaton itself. He also notes that the human eye can react to just one octave of all ten, the whole light of ordinary sunlight. The so-called ether, we are told, is merely a collective name for force and energy activities in space.

L127.t: Seven Reachings Out of Creative Mind
rows: The accomplishment of divine destinies—supreme, ultimate, and absolute
L127.d: The evolution of mechanisms implies and indicates the concealed presence and dominance of creative mind. The very ability of the mortal intellect to conceive, design, and create automatic mechanisms demonstrates the creative and purposive qualities of man's mind. This list names seven directions in which mind is always reaching out. It begins with the creation of material mechanisms and the discovery of hidden mysteries, proceeds through the exploration of remote situations, the formulation of mental systems, and the attainment of wisdom goals, and rises to the achievement of spirit levels and the accomplishment of divine destinies, supreme, ultimate, and absolute. The ascent runs from technology and science through philosophy and wisdom to spirituality and divine destiny. The text then affirms that mind is always creative, and summarizes: the spirit is the architect, the mind is the builder, the body is the material building.

L128.t: Twelve Vorondadek Sons in the Norlatiadek Government
rows: The Most High ruler of Norlatiadek, number 617,318 of the Vorondadek series
The personal representative of Michael since he became a Master Son
The personal representative of Gabriel, on Edentia since the Lucifer rebellion
The Most High chief of planetary observers
Director of the observers on the isolated worlds of Satania
Adjusts all difficulties consequential to rebellion within the constellation
Adapts emergency enactments to the rebellion-isolated worlds of Satania
Harmonizes the special bestowal adjustments on Urantia with routine administration
Head of the emergency tribunal for problems of the Satania rebellion
Special counselor with the Faithful of Days regarding rebellion
President of the emergency council of Edentia
L128.d: The rotation of the Most Highs on Edentia was suspended at the time of the Lucifer rebellion, and the same rulers remain on duty. Moreover, the present government of our constellation, Norlatiadek, has been expanded to include twelve Sons of the Vorondadek order. Apart from the Constellation Father and his two associates, most of the remaining nine hold offices arising from the Satania rebellion and its aftermath. The chief of planetary observers, the referee, the emergency administrator, the judge-advocate, the liaison, and the director of the emergency council all deal with the confusion caused by rebellion, while the mediator harmonizes the special adjustments of the bestowal on Urantia with routine constellation administration. That one system's rebellion reshaped a constellation government shows how wide and lasting its consequences are, and also how carefully universe government deals with them.

L129.t: Seven Lessons in the Socialization of the Morontia Personality
rows: Live happily and work effectively with ten diverse fellow morontians
Abide joyfully and co-operate heartily with ten univitatia
Achieve simultaneous adjustment to both fellow morontians and host univitatia
Achieve intellectual harmony with, and vocational adjustment to, both groups
Live in intimate contact with ever-lessening irritability and ever-diminishing resentment
Adjust all socialization techniques to the furtherance of the Paradise-ascension career
Climax multisocialization with the concurrent enhancement of spiritual insight
L129.d: On the mansion worlds the ascending mortal completes the unification of personality, and on the system capital gains the willingness to submit the self to the disciplines of group activities. Next, on the constellation training worlds, comes the real socialization of the evolving morontia personality. This list shows that process in seven steps. One lives and works with ten fellow morontians and with ten univitatia, similar intellectually but very different in every other way; adjusts to both groups at once; achieves intellectual harmony and vocational adjustment; and lessens irritability and resentment. Finally all of this is bound together with the goal of the ascension career and spiritual insight. The author notes that two moral creatures in partnership do not merely double but almost quadruple their possibilities of achievement. Learning to live with others is a serious educational task even in the universe.

L130.t: Seven Major Divisions of the Celestial Artisans
L130.d: The celestial artisans are registered on the superuniverse headquarters but directed by morontia supervisors on the local universe capitals, and they are commissioned in seven major divisions: musicians, reproducers, builders, thought recorders, energy manipulators, designers and embellishers, and harmony workers. The original teachers of all seven groups hailed from the perfect worlds of Havona, which contains the patterns for all phases and forms of spirit artistry. Transferring these arts of Havona to the worlds of space is a gigantic task, yet the artisans have improved in technique age by age. Ascenders first glimpse these arts on the mansion worlds, and their appreciation of beauty heightens until they stand in the spirit halls of Salvington. The author adds that all these morontia and spirit activities are real; to spirit beings the material world is the more unreal. Beauty is a substantial part of the ascending career.
